jobs.title: Gestionnaire d'estimations des pensions (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Avec ses quelques  collaborateurs, la Caisse nationale d'assurance pension (CNAP) est un établissement public ayant comme mission la gestion de l'assurance pension du régime général. En tant qu'interlocuteur unique en matier/ière de pension de tous les assurés du secteur privé, les salariés et non-salariés, elle assure le traitement des dossiers de pension et le paiement des prestations correspondant/antes. Dans l'exécution de ses missions, la CNAP collabore avec un large réseau de partenaires nationaux et internationaux et privilégie une gestion participative à tous les niveaux. La cellule « estimation des pensions » du service pension accompagne les futurs retraités en leur fournissant des conseils et évaluations personnalisées sur leurs droits à la retraite. Il analyse les carrier/ières d'assurance conformément aux réglementations nationales et internationales pour offrir des projections permettant aux assurés de planifier leur transition vers la retraite. Plus d'informations sur www.cnap.lu. La CNAP offre un environnement de travail collégial et pluridisciplinaire, un travail varié en constant/ante évolution et des possibilités de développement personnel. Missions Instruire les demandes de renseignement; Fournir des conseils et informations aux assurés; Établir le droit à la pension et l'estimation du montant des pensions; Analyser et appliquer des instructions internationales; Collaborer avec d'autres services de la CNAP (not. pension, carrier/ières d'assurance et accueil); Echanger avec les institutions étrangères compétentes en matier/ière d'assurance pension; Participer aux projets de la CNAP en relation avec les attributions. Profil Compétences techniques Avoir une excellente maîtrise des langues administratives (FR, DE, LU); Avoir une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais; Disposer de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles; Maîtriser les outils informatiques courants (Word, Excel, etc.) et les logiciels internes spécifiques; Apprendre et savoir appliquer la législation sur les pensions et les procédures de traitement des demandes. Compétences comportementales Être rigoureux, organisé et précis; Avoir un sens aigu des responsabilités et savoir gérer des priorités; Être fiable, disponible et flexible; Respecter la confidentialité et la discrétion; Avoir la capacité de travailler de manier/ière autonome ainsi qu'en équipe; Avoir une aisance relationnelle et l'esprit d'équipe. Atouts Avoir des connaissances sur l'assurance pension et l'affiliation; Avoir une premier/ière expérience professionnelle dans le traitement de dossiers administratifs. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes détenteur soit d'un diplôme de fin d'études secondaires (classiques ou générales), soit d'un diplôme de technicien, soit d'un brevet de maîtrise, soit d'un certificat sanctionnant des études reconnues équivalentes. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 4 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. jobs.title: Métrologue et analyste de données (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration luxembourgeoise vétérinaire et alimentaire (ALVA) a été créée en par le regroupement, au sein d'une administration unique, de la majeure partie des organes de contrôle de la chaîne alimentaire. Les missions de l'ALVA sont définies dans la loi du 8 septembre portant création et organisation de l'Administration luxembourgeoise vétérinaire et alimentaire. Lors de la mise en place du gouvernement actuel à la fin de l'année , il avait été décidé de poursuivre la réforme de consolidation entamée par le gouvernement précédent dans le domaine du contrôle de la chaîne alimentaire avec la création de la nouvelle Administration luxembourgeoise vétérinaire et alimentaire (ALVA). Dans ce cadre, le gouvernement avait décidé que le Service de surveillance alimentaire (SSA) du Laboratoire national de (LNS), serait transféré vers l'ALVA afin de le fusionner avec le Laboratoire de médecine vétérinaire de l'État (LMVE). Cette fusion, effective depuis le 1er janvier , a donné naissance au laboratoire vétérinaire et alimentaire (LVA), une division de l'ALVA placée sous la tutelle du ministère de l'Agriculture, de l'Alimentation et de la Viticulture. Elle constitue la dernier/ière étape visant à centraliser l'ensemble du contrôle de la chaîne alimentaire, couvrant à la fois l'inspection, la surveillance et les analyses de laboratoire, sous l'autorité d'un seul ministère. Missions En tant que Métrologue et Analyste de Données, vous êtes le référent en matier/ière de métrologie au sein du laboratoire vétérinaire et alimentaire. Vous coordonnez l'ensemble des activités métrologiques, veillez à la fiabilité des équipements de mesure en réalisant leur vérification et étalonnage et exploitez les données techniques du laboratoire en collaboration avec les responsables. À ce titre, vous assurez la coordination, la planification et la réalisation des activités de métrologie du laboratoire à Dudelange, en garantissant le bon fonctionnement quotidien et la conformité aux objectifs définis par la direction et le chef de division du laboratoire. Tâches principales: Gestion de la métrologie: Vous gérez l'ensemble des opérations de métrologie des équipements du laboratoire de l'ALVA à Dudelange;  Vous en planifiez les vérifications et étalonnages et pilotez le budget associé. Vous organisez et suivez les vérifications et étalonnages réalisés en interne et par des prestataires externes, évaluez la qualité des fournisseurs, administrez les logiciels de métrologie, notamment Saveris;  Vous animez les réunions métrologie et contribuez à la communication interne et externe du laboratoire;  Vous participez également à l'activité métrologique de l'ALVA à Strassen. Contrôle des équipements et expertise technique: Vous assurez la vérification et l'étalonnage des équipements du laboratoire, tels que les balances, thermomètres, masses de travail, pipettes, dispenseurs et enceintes; Vous proposez des actions d'optimisation et accompagnez les services techniques dans le suivi métrologique de leurs équipements spécifiques. Système qualité et conformité: Vous établissez et maintenez à jour la documentation de métrologie conformément à la norme ISO/IEC :;  Vous réalisez des analyses de risques en métrologie afin de proposer des actions correctives et préventives adaptées; Vous contribuez activement à l'amélioration continue du système qualité, participez aux audits internes et externes, veillez à la conformité réglementaire et participez à la préparation de la revue de direction en collaboration avec le service qualité. Analyse de données: Vous organisez, analysez et exploitez les données du laboratoire en vue de leur utilisation, notamment dans le cadre des dossiers de vérification et des différents rapports; Vous apportez votre expertise méthodologique et statistique, développez, rédigez et évaluez des requêtes, réalisez des analyses critiques, justifiez les résultats obtenus et proposez des pistes d'amélioration. Profil Compétences techniques Vous maîtrisez l'utilisation, la vérification et l'étalonnage des équipements de laboratoire (balances, thermomètres, pipettes, masses de travail, enceintes, etc.) et savez identifier les anomalies ainsi que leurs causes; Vous appliquez et développez les procédures internes; Vous conduisez des projets en assurant leur structuration, leur planification et leur suivi; Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques et les logiciels métiers; À court terme, vous serez capable d'utiliser SharePoint et les outils de gestion électronique des documents; À moyen terme, vous connaîtrez et appliquerez les exigences relatives à la métrologie (ISO/IEC : et normes ISO applicables). Compétences comportementales Développer une vue d'ensemble : Vous développez une vue d'ensemble, vous...

jobs.description: Notre client, entreprise reconnue dans le secteur des équipements de construction, de terrassement et de manutention, recherche un Technicien SAV Itinérant / Mécanicien Engins de Chantier (H/F/X) pour renforcer ses équipes techniques au Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. Vos qualités Vous êtes naturellement curieux et aimez comprendre le fonctionnement des machines. Vous avez une véritable envie d'apprendre et de développer vos compétences techniques. Vous êtes débrouillard, rigoureux et orienté solution. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez demander de l'aide lorsque cela est nécessaire. jobs.description: La FHL recrute un:  Médecin du travail (m/f) CDI à temps plein (statut salarié)  La Fédération des Hôpitaux Luxembourgeois est l'association qui a pour objet le groupement des établissements hospitaliers luxembourgeois, la défense de leurs intérêts professionnels et la réalisation sous toutes ses formes du progrès hospitalier pour concourir notamment au bien-être du patient. Dans un contexte multidisciplinaire, les collaborateurs de la FHL s'investissent, en relation étroite avec les membres de l'association, pour réaliser les projets d'un secteur en constant/ante évolution. Vous rejoignez l'équipe du Service Interentreprises de  au Travail du secteur hospitalier (SIST-FHL) en contact direct avec les organes décisionnels et les acteurs de terrain des hôpitaux luxembourgeois membres de la FHL.  Missions :  Le médecin du travail du SIST-FHL accomplit les missions suivant/antes auprès des établissements hospitaliers membres de la FHL : Surveiller la  des salariés en relation avec le travail et effectuer, à cet effet, les examens médicaux prévus par le Code du Travail; Identifier les risques d'atteinte à la  sur les lieux de travail et aider à éviter ces risques; Donner des conseils sur la planification des postes de travail, l'aménagement des lieux de travail, le choix des équipements de travail et promouvoir l'adaptation du travail à l'homme; Donner à l'employeur et au salarié des conseils dans les domaines de l'hygiène, de l'éducation à la  et de la réadaptation professionnelle.  Activités et tâches : Dans le cadre de son activité quotidien/ienne, le médecin du travail du SIST-FHL sera amené à :  Réaliser des examens médicaux dans les locaux de Bertrange ou dans les hôpitaux et communiquer les conclusions de ses examens médicaux aux différentes parties prenant/antes; Prescrire les analyses nécessaires à prévenir et surveiller l'atteinte à la  sur le lieu du travail; Réaliser les visites de postes, d'unités ou d'établissements pour analyser les conditions de travail; Conseiller l'employeur et les salariés sur la réduction des risques pour la  et d'éventuels aménagements de postes; Collaborer avec l'ensemble des autres acteurs, internes et externes, impliqués dans la  au travail du personnel des établissements membres de la FHL.  Profil :  Vous êtes titulaire d'une autorisation d'exercer la profession de médecin du travail ou de médecin spécialiste en médecine du travail; Un agrément de médecin du travail habilité en radioprotection est un avantage; Vous disposez d'une expérience de 3 ans au moins comme médecin du travail; Vous disposez d'une connaissance du secteur hospitalier et la compréhension de ses contraintes; Une expérience professionnelle de plusieurs années dans l'environnement hospitalier sera considérée comme un atout majeur; Vous maîtrisez le français et l'allemand (écrit, parlé et lu), la maîtrise de la langue luxembourgeoise est considérée comme un atout;  Vous disposez des compétences et qualités suivant/antes :  Connaissance de la législation nationale en matier/ière de droit du travail, Connaissance des métiers de la  et du fonctionnement d'un établissement hospitalier, Connaissance des outils MS Office, Diplomatie et écoute, Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, Sens de l'organisation et de la rigueur dans la planification, Réactivité et bonne gestion du stress, Adaptabilité et flexibilité.  Nous offrons:  Travail diversifié et intéressant, autonome et en équipe, Formation continue adaptée aux besoins, Horaire mobile, Jours de congés supérieurs au congé légal, Rémunération attrayant/ante, Locaux agréables et facilités de stationnement. Possibilité de télétravail.  Date prévisionnelle de prise de fonctions : à convenir.  Les candidatures sont à envoyer au Directeur de la FHL via Moovijob.com avec lettre de motivation, curriculum vitae et copies des diplômes et de l'autorisation d'exercer. Společnost EURONA s.r.o., hledá do týmu kolegu či kolegyni, které baví kombinace dat, kreativy a viditelných výsledků. Hledá člověka, který chce být součástí týmu přímo na pracovišti a vyhovuje mu každodenní spolupráce v kanceláři. Jedná se o pracovní poměr na dobu určitou s možností prodloužení na dobu neurčitou, pružná pracovní doba. Nástup možný ihned.
Pozice je vhodná i pro absolventy/absolventky.

Co Vás u nás čeká: správa a rozvoj firemních profilů na sociálních sítích (Facebook, Instagram) a firemního webu; plánování, tvorba a publikace obsahu včetně Reels, videí, fotografií a textů; vyhodnocování výkonnosti kampaní a příspěvků, práce s daty a návrhy na zlepšení; spolupráce na tvorbě a realizaci marketingové a obsahové strategie; samostatné vedení svěřených projektů a odpovědnost za jejich včasné dokončení; tvorba marketingových textů, korektury tiskovin, obalů a etiket produktů; správa produktového obsahu na webu, zadávání novinek, akcí a dalších marketingových aktivit.

Co od Vás očekáváme: zkušenosti nebo orientaci v online marketingu a sociálních sítích; analytické myšlení a schopnost pracovat s daty a vyhodnocovat výsledky; cit pro obsah, vizuální komunikaci a moderní trendy na sociálních sítích; spolehlivost, aktivitu a chuť přicházet s vlastními nápady; schopnost efektivně spolupracovat v týmu a být součástí každodenního dění ve firmě; možnost a ochotu vykonávat práci každodenně na pracovišti zaměstnavatele (pozice neumožňuje home office ani práci na dálku).

Co Vám nabízíme: zajímavou a různorodou práci s možností vidět konkrétní výsledky své práce; stabilní zázemí prosperující české společnosti; práci v přátelském a neformálním kolektivu; prostor pro vlastní iniciativu, nápady a profesní rozvoj; motivační finanční ohodnocení; příspěvek na stravování a penzijní nebo životní pojištění.

v rozmezí 25 190 - 36 210,- Kč + pohyblivá složka platu, která může činit 25-40%  ročních příjmů (osobní příplatek, odměny). Plat se řídí dle NV č. 341/2017 Sb. a záleží na dosažené praxi.

Rámcová pracovní náplň:

"    Zajišťuje průběžnou kontrolu správu a údržbu svěřeného majetku na přiděleném území města Plzně.

"    Zabezpečuje převzetí dokončených staveb s důrazem na doložení předepsaných dokladů a zkoušek.
"    Účastní se přejímek dokončených investičních akcí a uplatňuje své požadavky v přejímacím území.

jobs.title: Home and Office Cleaner
jobs.description:
Hyvinkään Kotisiivous Oy currently has approximately 180 regular cleaning customers per month, most of whom are private households in Hyvinkää and the surrounding areas. About 10 of these are business customers, in addition to a few stairwell cleaning sites. During the summer season, additional work mainly consists of cleaning windows and balcony glazing.

Workdays usually begin in the morning at the office, from where employees travel to the cleaning sites using the companys vans, and return to the same location at the end of the workday. For this reason, a valid driving licence and good driving skills for operating a van are required. Cleaning work at the sites is carried out mainly using the companys own cleaning products and equipment.

The companys current working languages are English and Finnish. These languages are also used as the customer service languages in the office, depending on the cleaners level of Finnish language skills. The job of a cleaner requires good physical endurance as well as strong mental resilience, as the expectations of several different customers must be met every day. The job requirements are introduced during a three-week training period, after which the employee continues working together with a more experienced cleaning pair.

Company can arrange a housing benefit in the center of Hyvinkää if needed.

jobs.description:
- Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in hydrologie, (geo-)hydrologie, fysische geografie, earth sciences of vergelijkbaar.
- Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in zelfstandige hydrologische modellering en/of geo-data engineering.
- Ervaring met SWAP-modellering, Hydrus, inclusief kalibratie en batchuitvoer.
- Werkervaring met Python voor data- en modelautomatisering (pandas, geopandas, rasterio).
- Praktische ervaring met Flask of vergelijkbare frameworks, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, en het bouwen van eenvoudige REST API's voor het ontsluiten van spatial data.
- Werkervaring met QGIS en/of ArcGIS, inclusief scripting waar nodig.
- Vaardigheid met frontend-visualisatie via Leaflet, Chart.js of vergelijkbare bibliotheken.
- Communicatievaardigheden in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk (minimaal B2).  
- Een zelfstandige werkhouding, je levert end-to-end op zonder dagelijkse aansturing.

AtlaTerra is een onafhankelijk onderzoeks- en adviesbureau op het gebied van bodem, water en klimaat. In het kleine Nederland is de beschikbare ruimte beperkt. De ruimtelijke gebruiksfuncties zoals landbouw, natuur, stedelijk gebied en infrastructuur zijn hierdoor sterk verweven. De rol: We zoeken een hydroloog/geo-data specialist die zelfstandig opdrachten oppakt en uitvoert, van modelwerk tot het toegankelijk maken van de uitkomsten. Je werkt direct met de opdrachtgever en bent inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk van begin tot eind.

Wat ga je doen: - Je voert hydrologische modelstudies en scenario-analyses uit met onverzadigde zone modellen zoals SWAP en Hydrus inclusief de bijbehorende Python-toolchain, kalibratie, batch scenario's en interpretatie van hydrologische statistieken.
- Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt reproduceerbare Python-pipelines (pandas, geopandas, rasterio) die op meerdere rekeneenheden tegelijk kunnen draaien.
- Je bouwt en onderhoudt de data- en webcomponenten waarmee modeluitkomsten toegankelijk worden voor opdrachtgevers, backend (Flask, PostgreSQL/PostGIS), eenvoudige REST API's en frontend-visualisatie (Leaflet, Chart.js).
- Je verwerkt landelijke geodata (BRO, AHN, bodemkaart, landgebruik) tot modelinvoer en visualiseert uitkomsten in kaarten en beelden voor niet-technische gebruikers.
- Je bent het aanspreekpunt gedurende de opdracht, bewaakt je eigen planning en signaleert tijdig wanneer iets buiten scope gaat of vertraging dreigt.

jobs.title: Programme Manager
jobs.description:
ResultsinHealth (RiH) is looking for an energetic Programme Manager to join our Procurement and Supply chain Management (PSM) team in Leiderdorp. We are recruiting a new colleague with a hands-on mentality who is driven, diplomatic, organized, enthusiastic, tenacious, positive and cheerful.

Responsibilities
- Manage the RiH PSM portfolios: Ensure implementation and follow-up of multiple concurrent country workplans and services,
- Provide administrative support for RiH Experts on contracting, invoicing, communication, travel bookings, visas, report editing, and completeness of deliverables,
- Participate in New Business activities, develop expressions of interest for funders,
- Support the development and rollout of new initiatives, including RiHRecruit.com,
- Coordinate recruitment, maintenance, and management of RiH pool of Experts,
- Regular communication with RiH experts and partners backstopping teams,
- Provide coordination and support on supply chain assignments and Global Fund technical areas when applicable (based on skills and interest),
- Assist with improvements to RiH work processes and tools, strategic initiatives,
- Represent RiH at conferences, meetings and trainings when appropriate,
- Coordinate the provision of materials for RiH communication and outreach,
- Coordinate organization and liaison for meetings or training with experts/clients and in-house capacity building

ResultsinHealth is an international development advisory firm located in The Netherlands.
RiH is dedicated to effective disease prevention and to improving access to health care. We strengthen health systems and monitor the progress of program implementation. Based on our work and recommendations, donor agencies and governments make evidence-based decisions on spending for medicines and health products and controlling risks in supply chains for optimized efficiency.

Our largest client is the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GF). Since 2003, RiH has been a trusted and respected partner in evaluating supply chains in countries that receive GF grants. We work in more than 50 countries worldwide with a large group of experts, mainly pharmacists and laboratory specialists.

RiH is a lean and flexible organization recognized for its responsiveness to specific needs while providing excellent and solutions-oriented services to its clients. Recently, we launched RiHRecruit.com; global recruitment services for challenging roles in public health.

Visit our website for more information about our company and the vacancy: www.resultsinhealth.org

Regular plant care encompasses comprehensive maintenance activities, including preventive maintenance, routine inspections, equipment servicing, and system optimization. The Hague Centre for Strategic Studies (HCSS) is a leading think tank that provides strategic support to public and private organisations. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Business Development
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead and scale our outbound sales development team as we expand our go-to-market efforts. This role will oversee a team of BDRs (Business Development Representatives) proactively targeting and engaging high-potential accounts to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on outbound prospecting experience and proven leadership skills, a strong understanding of the modern GTM technology, previous experience in creating systems and orchestrating technology to support an efficient & scalable 0->1 outbound workflow, and previous experience collaborating tightly with marketing and sales ops to build highly-targeted account lists and multi-channel outreach sequences. Experience & interest in vibe coding and/or technical experience is highly valued.

This position is critical to our go-to-market strategy, responsible for defining our outbound playbook, identifying key target personas, hiring top-tier talent, coaching team members, and ensuring persistent, high-quality outreach & pipeline generation across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for proven sales development professionals who excel in both strategic account targeting and team leadership, with a passion for technology and AI. You'll leverage your expertise to build a world-class BDR organization that effectively cuts through the noise to communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of Business Development Representatives

 - Develop and implement BDR processes, playbooks, and best practices for cold and warm-outbound channels

 - Coach and mentor BDRs on qualification methodology, objection handling, and pipeline generation techniques

 - Partner with sales leadership to provide feedback on territory assignments, quotas, performance metrics, lead handoff processes

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ensuring your team can articulate this vision compellingly

 - Collaborate with marketing and operations to optimize lead routing, provide feedback on campaign effectiveness, and improve lead quality & conversion

 - Analyze team performance data and implement strategies to improve conversion rates and meeting quality

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard new SDR/BDR team members as the organization scales

 - Maintain accountability for team quota attainment and individual BDR development

 - Work closely with Account Executives and AE leaders to ensure smooth handoffs and tight feedback loops

 - Uphold CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy across the SDR organization

 - Stay current on industry trends and competitive landscape to inform team strategy




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years of sales development experience with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role, preferably some with a technical ICP

 - Proven track record of building and scaling BDR teams, preferably in a high-growth environment

 - Strong individual contributor background with deep understanding of both inbound & outbound prospecting, demand gen strategies, and industry best practices

 - Excellent coaching and mentoring abilities with experience developing junior sales talent

 - Data-driven approach to performance management and process optimization

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

 - Experience with CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot/SFDC, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Clay, SmartLead, Outreach, Default, etc)

 - Ability to recruit, interview, and assess SDR candidates effectively

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with marketing and sales teams

 - Passion for technology and ability to quickly learn and teach complex technical concepts

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus




NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Experience building inbound SDR programs from 0-1 and/or scaling from early stage

 - Basic understanding of software development or coding concepts

 - Experience with multi-channel prospecting (email, phone, social)

 - Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience)




TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM (Salesforce coming soon)

 - ZoomInfo

 - Outreach

 - Gong

 - Chorus

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - Nooks

 - Default

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You're not based in the Salt Lake City area and/or willing to relocate

 - You have no interest in understanding the software development lifecycle or learning basic coding concepts

 - You're not passionate about AI

 - You prefer individual contributor work over people management and team building

 - You're uncomfortable with a fast-paced startup environment where priorities may shift quickly



This is a full-time hybrid role and has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

Vi tilbyr en variert stilling med gode utviklingsmuligheter i et selskap med bred virksomhet innen eiendom og nye energirelaterte prosjekter.

Vi søker erfarne industrirørleggere. Som industrirørlegger vil du inngå i et team som utfører montasje, vedlikehold og feilsøking på røranlegg, ventiler og tilknyttede komponenter. Oppdragene er varierende og kan innebære arbeid i både inn- og utland avhengig av kundens behov.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter søkere som har fagbrev som rørlegger eller relevant erfaring fra industrien. Du bør ha erfaring med både mekanisk arbeid og rørmontasje, samt forståelse for ulike materialer og metodevalg. Videre ønsker vi:

  • Minimum 3 års erfaring fra industrirørlegging eller tilsvarende

  • Kunnskap om sveising

  • Gjeldene HMS-kurs og sertifikater etter behov

  • Fleksibilitet, selvstendighet og gode samarbeidsevner

Arbeidsoppgaver

Du vil ha ansvar for sikker og effektiv gjennomføring av rørarbeid etter tegning og kravspesifikasjon. Typiske oppgaver:

  • Montasje og sveising av rør og rørkomponenter

  • Montering av ventiler, flenser og støtter

  • Feilsøking, utskifting og reparasjon

  • Lesing av tekniske tegninger og arbeid etter prosedyrer

  • Oppfølging av HSE-rutiner og rapportering

Som utleid industrirørlegger får du varierte oppdrag, konkurransedyktige betingelser og tett oppfølging fra vårt bemanningsbyrå. Vi legger vekt på trygghet, godt arbeidsmiljø og oppdrag som matcher din kompetanse. Mulighet for faste oppdrag ved god match mellom kandidat og kunde.

Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og tar kontakt ved aktuelle kandidater.

**Position:**Head Chef

Contract Duration: Full time.

Location: Restaurant Sjyen, Midtre gate 3, 8622 Mo i Rana, Norway

Employment: Full-time (100%)

Salary: Negotiable based on experience!

About the Role

Restaurant Sjyen is looking for a passionate and skilled head chef to join our team. We specialize in high-quality casual food, with a strong focus on seafood, fresh produce, and locally sourced ingredients. Our kitchen is fast-paced and dynamic, requiring a head chef who thrives under pressure and enjoys working as part of a team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and cook a variety of seafood and fish dishes, as well as other menu items using fresh ingredients.

  • Work efficiently in a busy kitchen environment, ensuring high standards of food quality and presentation.

  • Collaborate with the team to maintain a smooth and productive kitchen workflow.

  • Adhere to health and safety regulations and maintain cleanliness in the kitchen.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Previous experience in a similar role, preferably in a seafood-focused restaurant.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a high-pressure, fast-paced kitchen environment.

  • Strong teamwork skills and a positive attitude.

  • English proficiency is required; additional language skills are a plus.

  • Passion for fresh, high-quality ingredients and seasonal cooking.

Why Join Us?

  • Work in a restaurant that values fresh, local ingredients and high-quality food.

  • Be part of a dedicated and professional kitchen team.

  • Experience the beautiful surroundings of Mo i Rana, with opportunities to enjoy Norway's stunning nature.


If you are an experienced head chef looking for an exciting opportunity, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of the Restaurant Sjyen team.

How to Apply:

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to post@restaurantsjyen.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Restaurant Sjyen in Mo i Rana is known for its use of high-quality local ingredients, with a particular focus on seafood and shellfish from the surrounding area. The menu is seasonal, highlighting fresh ingredients from the sea, prepared using a combination of traditional and modern culinary techniques. The restaurant places great emphasis on creating a complete dining experience, where carefully selected wines elegantly complement the dishes. With a welcoming atmosphere and a strong commitment to quality in both food and service, Sjyen has become a popular choice for both locals and visiting food enthusiasts.

jobs.title: Principal Counsel, Africa Legal
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. 

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments.

You will independently lead all Africa Legal & Compliance operations and strategy while serving as an integral member of Zipline International's high-impact Legal Team. You will also be a key member of the Zipline Africa Leadership Team, with the Heads of People and Finance and our Country Directors, and with a dotted reporting line to Zipline Africa's CEO. You will work cross-functionally with the Africa Leadership Team, Operations, Policy, Government Affairs, People, Finance, and Engineering, and will report directly to Zipline's Deputy General Counsel.

This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, scale, and continuously improve Zipline's legal and compliance programs across Africa, with a focus on sustainable, practical operations that support rapid growth
  • Lead day-to-day compliance workstreams covering sanctions, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, privacy, healthcare, employment, and product-related regulations
  • Support internal investigations, audits, and risk assessments, partnering closely with People, Finance, and senior leadership
  • Manage litigation and disputes across Zipline's African markets 
  • Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for business and technical teams
  • Own compliance with U.S. government award requirements, including FARs and 2 CFR 200, and serve as a primary point of contact for U.S. government contracting officers (including at the U.S. Department of State)
  • Monitor and assess regulatory and policy developments across relevant African jurisdictions and advise leadership on emerging risks and opportunities

Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture

  • Act as a senior legal advisor to business leaders, providing pragmatic, risk-calibrated guidance 
  • Build strong relationships across the company and help foster a durable "culture of compliance" where teams understand the rules of the road and feel empowered to raise issues early
  • Help shape Zipline's long-term legal and regulatory strategy in Africa, balancing compliance rigor with innovation and speed

What You'll Bring

  • A willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar issues and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-environments
  • Strong judgment and the confidence to make independent decisions, coupled with the discernment to escalate when appropriate
  • Experience advising on legal and compliance matters, preferably in international or emerging-market environments
  • The ability to break down complex legal and regulatory problems into clear priorities and practical solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to advise senior stakeholders
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset and strong organizational skills
  • Willingness to travel up to ~25% to Africa and San Francisco headquarters

What Else You Need To Know

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Soho, London

Hybrid working: 3 days in the office Tues - Thurs

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Team, taking a leading role in building the complex, scalable systems that power our data strategy. You will lead architectural discussions, own the design of business-critical data solutions and deliver high-quality systems that bring millions of fans closer to the sports they love. This is a fantastic opportunity to lead the optimisation of our data platforms for real-time AI/ML workloads, mentor engineers and make a significant impact on our business. The Senior Data Engineer leads technical initiatives, maintains data integrity and performance, and works across teams to translate complex business requirements into effective data solutions. The role also uses automation and artificial intelligence to improve efficiency, decision-making and productivity across the organisation.

At LiveScore Group, we're the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top.

We don't just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it's our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you're good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.

We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting, and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you're passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you! 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead the design and delivery of robust data pipelines using GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage. This includes integrating data from various sources, ensuring data quality and enabling real-time processing capabilities.
  • Own the design of data models and databases that support business analytics and intelligence, using dimensional data-modelling principles. Select and use GCP database technologies such as Bigtable, Spanner or Firestore to optimise performance and scalability.
  • Lead the automation of data workflows and optimisation of data storage and processing costs within GCP. Use tools such as Cloud Composer for orchestration and establish best practices in performance tuning.
  • Ensure data security by implementing GCP security practices. Manage access controls, comply with data-governance policies and safeguard sensitive information.
  • Work closely with data engineers, business analysts and IT teams to define data requirements and deliver comprehensive data solutions. Provide technical leadership and guidance to team members.
  • Evaluate new GCP features and data-engineering technologies, setting technical direction where they can enhance data infrastructure or enable new data products.
  • Lead the resolution of critical pipeline failures and data-quality incidents, performing fault analysis and ensuring that preventative improvements are implemented.
  • Lead critical system-design and architectural decisions for scalable batch and real-time workloads.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate complex or ambiguous business needs into effective and innovative data solutions.
  • Mentor engineers, review technical designs and foster a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.
  • Own improvements to the reliability, performance and cost-effectiveness of data systems.
  • Lead the design and maintenance of robust, secure integrations with core internal systems and critical third-party platforms.
  • Define appropriate monitoring and alerting standards to ensure high system reliability and minimal downtime.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

  • Significant experience in data engineering or data warehousing with large-scale, complex datasets.
  • Advanced SQL and Python skills, with experience using AI-assisted development tools appropriately.
  • Strong knowledge of data-modelling techniques.
  • Deep experience with cloud data services and technologies, ideally within the GCP ecosystem, such as Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery or Vertex AI.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing robust ELT pipelines, including real-time and large-scale batch processing.
  • Proven ability to deploy and maintain data infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code principles and tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience with Airflow environment management and Docker.
  • Experience contributing to an AI roadmap and evaluating AI tooling, including coding agents, for use within the development lifecycle.
  • The ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrable experience applying data-governance, privacy and security best practices in a regulated environment.
  • A proactive and curious approach, with the ability to anticipate and resolve system inefficiencies.
  • The ability to lead cross-functional technical work and translate complex or ambiguous requirements into robust data solutions.
  • A track record of taking end-to-end ownership for the quality, reliability and performance of business-critical data solutions.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical standards across a team.

What can we offer? 

  • Company Performance Bonus
  • Flexible Working Agreements where applicable
  • Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay
  • Subsidised Gym Membership
  • Annual Travel Card Loan & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
  • Contributory Pension Plan
  • Virgin Family: Giving you access to exclusive Virgin offers and experiences
  • Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials

The Supply Chain Environmental Specialist supports the development and delivery of Vodafone's environmental strategy across supply chain categories and markets. The role focuses on category-level climate transition planning, supplier engagement, emissions reduction, and capability building within procurement, ensuring purchased goods and services align with Vodafone's 2030 reduction milestones and 2040 Net Zero ambition.
The role sits within Vodafone Procure & Connect (VP&C) in Luxembourg and reports into Vodafone Group's Sustainable Business Team, which sets global sustainability strategy and partners with business units to drive delivery. This is a growing and high-impact area, offering the opportunity to work with sustainability and supply chain experts while engaging a wide range of stakeholders across markets and functions. The role requires a self-driven individual with strong communication and programme management skills, comfortable creating new ways of working.

1. Category climate transition strategies
Support the development of category-specific climate transition plans aligned to Net Zero 2040.
Conduct baseline assessments to identify emissions hotspots, risks, opportunities, and KPIs.
Embed environmental criteria into category planning to support long-term decarbonization.
2. Procurement collaboration & decision-making support
Support the implementation of sustainable procurement processes, including environmental requirements and contract terms.
Partner with category managers to embed carbon reduction targets, environmental KPIs, and climate-aligned supplier selection.
Provide climate data, insights, and analysis to support responsible sourcing decisions.
Support ESG assessments within RFQs, guiding suppliers and integrating results into scoring models.

Facilitate workshops and learning sessions to embed sustainability into BAU procurement activities.
5. Environmental data, reporting & governance

jobs.title: Cytogeneticist (m/f)
jobs.description:
Cytogeneticist (m/f) Ref°49800

TYPE DE CONTRAT : CDI - temps plein

The Laboratoire national de santé (Luxembourg public institution) is recruiting a Cytogeneticist  (m/f)  for a full time (40 h/week) role and permanent  contract at the National Center of Genetics in the Hematooncogenetics-Cytogenetics Service.

ABOUT THE LABORATOIRE NATIONAL DE SANTE

The LNS is a major player in Luxembourg's healthcare sector, serving the country's patients, doctors and hospitals. Under the supervision of the Ministry of Health and Social Security, the LNS is a multidisciplinary public institution organized around six medical departments, two of which are designated as national diagnostic centers for human genetics and pathology respectively.

The LNS employs around 400 highly qualified staff with diverse backgrounds. The main purpose of the LNS is to develop analytical activities and scientific expertise relating to the prevention, diagnosis and monitoring of human diseases; to act as a national control or reference laboratory; and to carry out forensic missions. The LNS also collaborates with the University of Luxembourg and other biomedical research institutions, both nationally and internationally, on research and teaching activities.

In particular, in the field of diagnostics, the LNS covers the following fields of application: medical biology, microbiology, forensic medicine, environmental medicine, morphological and molecular pathology, and clinical genetics, as well as sequencing for rare diseases, oncology and pathogens.

About NATIONAL CENTER OF GENETICS

The NCG at the LNS has approximately 45 employees and is subdivided into three services:

1) Clinical Genetics Service, 2) Hemato-Oncogenetics-Cytogenetics Service, 3) Molecular Genetics Service

The Hemato-Oncogenetics and Cytogenetics team is involved in pre- and postnatal diagnosis (constitutional chromosomal aberrations) and hematooncogenetic diagnosis (acquired aberrations) of patients with hematological neoplasia.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated cytogeneticist to join our dynamic team in the Hematooncogenetics-Cytogenetics service. These tasks await you here:

- Supervise and manage a team of laboratory technicians and scientists in cytogenetics.
- Direct the daily operations of the cytogenetic laboratory
- Develop, validate and implement new procedures and techniques
- Interpret and communicate genetic results to physicians and others health professionals.
- Keep up to date with the latest developments and advances in the field
- Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and guidelines
- Actively participate in the training of medical students, residents and colleagues.
- Participate in the Center's translational research activities.
- Collaborate closely with the other services of the NCG (clinical genetics, molecular genetics and hemato-oncogenetics) and with external partners, in particular healthcare professionals, in order to provide comprehensive patient care and diagnostics of point.
- Represent the NCG at internal and external meetings and conferences as well as in national public health programs and working groups (e.g. the National Rare Disease Program).

Qualifications:

- Medical Doctor certified in medical genetics/cytogenetics, or equivalent
- Eligible to obtain an authorization to practice as a doctor in Luxembourg (Mandatory)

(http://www.sante.public.lu/fr/formulaires/professions/auteuration-exercise-profession-health/index.html)

- At least 5 years of experience in a cytogenetics laboratory (prenatal and postnatal)

- Strong knowledge of (molecular) cytogenetic techniques, including Karyotyping and FISH
- Strong leadership and team management skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Work experience in accredited medical laboratory (ISO 15189) is an advantage.
- Strong IT skills, including proficiency in laboratory IT systems (LIMS).
- Advanced English knowledge in spoken and written is required, knowledge of German or French are an advantage

If you meet the above profile and wish to apply, please submit your application (CV and covering letter) via our website. Your application will be treated confidentially.

At the final stages of the recruitment process, the successful candidate will be asked to provide supporting documentation such as, copies of diplomas and certificates of employment. An official criminal record (bulletin no.3) will also be required for consultation purpose.

Working closely with the Business Head and Relationship Managers, you will drive disciplined delivery of Net New Money (NNM) and revenue, while safeguarding segment and book purity and ensuring a consistently strong client experience. As a senior member within the Luxembourg Front Office management team, you will also be accountable for governance and risk management processes and provide supervisory oversight of business activities.

• Deliver market financial targets (revenue, margin, profitability, cost-to-serve where applicable), monitor performance drivers (mix, pricing, attrition, productivity), and ensure transparent forecasting by high-quality management information.

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

Research Portfolio
The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The candidate will develop and lead an ambitious research agenda in areas such as population health, primary care, prevention, health systems, epidemiology, health inequalities, data driven health sciences, and digital health.

Policy and Practice Integration
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. This will enhance the practical application of public health principles in healthcare and policy contexts. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

For further information about the role, please contact: Serge Haan, Head of DHML, Email: serge.haan@uni.lu


Your profile
• MD/PhD or PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Systems, or a closely related field. An MD is considered an asset
• Extensive experience in public health research and/or practice, ideally with a strong track record in population health, primary care, health policy, or health systems analysis
• Substantial teaching experience in public health, epidemiology, or health sciences at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels, preferably within medical, nursing, or life sciences programs
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching, particularly in integrating public health with medicine, life sciences, and nursing
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement new educational courses, including modules on health systems, epidemiology, and preventive strategies
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, such as online learning platforms, simulation-based training, data-driven case studies, and interactive policy analysis

Language requirements
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. However, a strong command of French is considered a significant asset. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:

• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
We encourage early application. Applications are only accepted online through the HR system. The position will be unposted on 24th September 2026, after which no further applications can be submitted. Applications will be handled in strict confidence.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

Excellent written and spoken command of English and German, additional languages are a plus.
Audit capabilities, Audit skill & knowledge, good relationship skills

jobs.title: Senior Fund Legal Counsel – UCITS, Prospectus Drafting & CSSF Regulatory Projects (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Fund Legal Counsel – UCITS, Prospectus Drafting & CSSF Regulatory Projects

Join Fundsight in Luxembourg and take ownership of high-impact UCITS product development, prospectus drafting and CSSF submissions for international clients.

Location: Luxembourg, Cloche d'Or | Languages: Fluent English and French required | Seniority: Senior legal role within a regulated Management Company and AIFM

About Fundsight

Fundsight S.A. is an independent Luxembourg Management Company and AIFM providing fund governance, regulatory and administration solutions to an international client base of asset managers, investment funds and institutional sponsors. As a regulated third-party ManCo operating in a demanding and fast-moving market, we offer our people direct exposure to sophisticated fund structures, high-quality clients and meaningful regulatory projects.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Fund Legal Counsel – UCITS, Prospectus Drafting & CSSF Regulatory Projects to join our expanding legal team and play a visible role in the continued development of our Luxembourg platform.

This role is primarily dedicated to UCITS product development, prospectus drafting, fund documentation and CSSF regulatory submissions across the full lifecycle of Luxembourg investment funds. You will lead complex legal and regulatory projects, advise international clients and act as a key point of contact for the CSSF, service providers and internal stakeholders.

The position combines technical fund law expertise, client-facing advisory work and hands-on project management. It is designed for a lawyer who enjoys taking ownership, working close to the business and contributing to the growth of a modern, entrepreneurial and internationally connected Management Company.

Your Role

UCITS Product Development & Fund Documentation

• Lead the drafting, review and coordination of UCITS prospectuses and related fund documentation.

• Take responsibility for legal and regulatory workstreams relating to:

o Fund launches;
o Sub-fund launches;
o Share class creations;
o Mergers;
o Liquidations;
o Restructurings;
o Investment policy amendments;
o Fee, governance and operational changes; and
o Other events requiring CSSF approval, notification or regulatory filing.

• Coordinate updates to articles of incorporation, management regulations and other key fund documentation.
• Liaise with clients, investment managers, depositaries, administrators, distributors, external counsel and other service providers throughout project implementation.

Alternative Investment Funds

• Review and coordinate legal documentation relating to AIFs and alternative investment structures, while the main drafting focus remains on UCITS documentation.
• Support projects involving RAIFs, SIFs, SICARs and other alternative investment vehicles.

CSSF Affairs & Regulatory Filings

• Prepare, coordinate and oversee CSSF submissions relating primarily to UCITS funds and, where relevant, AIF structures.
• Act as a primary contact during regulatory approval processes and CSSF follow-up requests.
• Manage fund lifecycle regulatory filings and ensure timely completion of regulatory obligations.
• Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting Luxembourg investment funds and assess their impact on existing structures and documentation.

Legal Review & Contractual Matters

• Review, negotiate and coordinate fund-related agreements.
• Support the onboarding and oversight of service providers and distribution networks.
• Provide practical and commercially focused legal advice to clients and internal stakeholders.

Client & Project Management

• Act as a trusted legal advisor for a portfolio of international clients.
• Lead complex legal and regulatory projects from inception through implementation.
• Coordinate effectively with regulators, clients, service providers and internal teams across multiple jurisdictions.
• Ensure high-quality delivery under demanding regulatory and commercial deadlines.

Candidate Profile

Education & Experience

• Master's Degree in Law or an equivalent legal qualification.
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience gained within:

o A Luxembourg Management Company;
o An AIFM;
o A law firm; or
o A specialised investment fund services provider.

• Proven experience in UCITS prospectus drafting, CSSF approval processes and Luxembourg fund lifecycle events is essential.
• Experience managing fund lifecycle events and regulatory projects is highly desirable.
Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of:

• UCITS regulation and Luxembourg investment fund law;
• Fund governance and lifecycle events;
• CSSF regulatory requirements and approval processes; and
• Alternative investment fund structures, including RAIFs, SIFs and SICARs.
Knowledge of French and/or Belgian investment fund regulation would be considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

• Excellent legal drafting and analytical skills.
• Strong project management and organisational abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple complex matters simultaneously.
• Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.
• Client-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness.
• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
• Ability to work autonomously whilst collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Languages

• Fluent English (written and spoken).
• Fluent French (written and spoken).
• Ability to draft and review legal documentation in both languages.

Why Join Fundsight?

• Take ownership of sophisticated UCITS legal and regulatory projects from structuring to launch.
• Draft and manage prospectuses and key fund documentation for international asset managers and fund sponsors.
• Work at the heart of CSSF approval processes, regulatory filings and fund lifecycle events.
• Join a growing, entrepreneurial and independent Luxembourg Management Company and AIFM.
• Benefit from direct client exposure, visible responsibility and close interaction with senior decision-makers.
• Collaborate with experienced professionals across legal, compliance, risk, oversight and business development functions.
• Work from modern offices in Cloche d'Or, Luxembourg, in the heart of a dynamic business district.
• Enjoy flexible working arrangements, a teleworking policy, lunch vouchers and additional private health insurance.
• Gain international exposure through leading asset managers, investment funds and institutional clients.
• Develop your career in a role combining technical excellence, business proximity and long-term growth opportunities.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a commercially minded investment funds lawyer with strong technical expertise in Luxembourg UCITS, proven experience in prospectus drafting and a solid understanding of CSSF approval processes. The ideal candidate is precise, pragmatic and client-oriented, with the ability to manage several complex matters in parallel while maintaining high-quality standards.
If you are ready to take a visible senior role in UCITS product development and regulatory projects within a growing Luxembourg ManCo/AIFM, we would be pleased to hear from you.

In dieser Position arbeitest Du an Luftfahrzeug- und Kabinenkomponenten und sorgst für ihre Sicherheit und Einsatzbereitschaft. Dabei verbindest du präzise handwerkliche Arbeit mit Deinem hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsanspruch.

- Durchführung von Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten an Luftfahrzeugkomponenten

- Regelmäßige Kontrollen und Checks gemäß Vorgaben
- Dokumentation der durchgeführten Arbeiten
- Einhaltung von Ordnung, Sicherheit und Qualitätsstandards
- Fachliche Kommunikation im Team und mit Vorgesetzten

Das hast Du im Gepäck:

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (wie z. B. als Kfz-Mechatroniker/in, Mechaniker/in, Werkzeugmechaniker, usw.)
- Auch Quereinsteiger mit technischer Ausbildung sind willkommen und werden entsprechend eingearbeitet

- Eigenständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise
- Bereitschaft, im Team mit anzupacken
- Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft (Einsätze teilweise europaweit, perspektivisch international)
- Grundkenntnisse im Umgang mit dem PC und gängigen Arbeitsprogrammen wie Word, Excel und Outlook
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und sichere Englischkenntnisse: In der Luftfahrt ist Englisch die Amtssprache und alle technischen Dokumente werden in Englisch verfasst, daher solltest Du über gute Englischkenntnisse verfügen

jobs.title: Nachhilfelehrer*in für sozial benachteiligte Kinder (m/w/d) (Nachhilfelehrer/in)
jobs.description:
Seit über einem Jahrzehnt begleiten wir Schülerinnen und Schüler auf ihrem Bildungsweg – von der Einschulung bis zum Schulabschluss. Unser Ziel ist es, durch individuellen und maßgeschneiderten Nachhilfeunterricht die Freude am Lernen zu fördern und gleichzeitig messbare Leistungssteigerungen zu erzielen.
Unsere Nachhilfe zeichnet sich durch eine pädagogisch durchdachte und anschauliche Vermittlung der Unterrichtsinhalte aus, die den Bedürfnissen jedes einzelnen Kindes gerecht wird. Besonders stolz sind wir auf unsere Arbeit mit Kindern und Jugendlichen aus einkommensschwachen Familien: Über ein Bildungspaket ermöglichen wir ihnen kostenlose Nachhilfe und schaffen so echte Bildungschancen für alle.

Was erwartet dich?

Du bist sozial engagiert und suchst einen flexiblen Nebenjob, der wirklich etwas bewirkt? Dann bist du beim Bund für Lernförderung genau richtig! Wer wir sind: Der Bund für Lernförderung bietet Kindern und Jugendlichen aus einkommensschwachen Familien durch ein gefördertes Bildungspaket kostenlose Nachhilfe an. Unsere Arbeit ermöglicht Chancengleichheit und schafft Perspektiven – und dafür brauchen wir DICH! Wen wir suchen: Unsere Nachhilfelehrer:innen kommen aus den unterschiedlichsten Lebensbereichen:

Rentner:innen

ehemalige wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiter:innen

Studierende und Hochschulabsolvent:innen

Lehrkräfte mit abgeschlossenem Studium

Fachleute aus der freien Wirtschaft

Für uns ist nicht den Bildungsweg entscheidend, sondern dass du Leidenschaft, Einfühlungsvermögen und Einsatzbereitschaft mitbringst. Deine Aufgaben:

Individuelle Förderung von Schüler:innen bei ihnen zu Hause in frei wählbaren Fächern und Klassenstufen

Unterstützung bei Hausaufgaben, Prüfungsvorbereitung und Arbeitsorganisation

Eigenverantwortliches und flexibles Arbeiten

Das bringst du mit:

-
Spaß und Motivation: Es bereitet dir Freude, Schüler:innen zu unterstützen und ihnen Wissen zu vermitteln.

Erfahrung: Idealerweise hast du bereits Nachhilfeerfahrung, sei es privat oder in einem Nachhilfeinstitut.

Qualifikation: Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Lehrkräften, Lehramtsstudierenden, Akademiker:innen, Dolmetscher:innen, Übersetzer:innen, Pädagog:innen sowie Studierenden aller Fachrichtungen.

Persönliche Eignung: Du bist zuverlässig, pünktlich und hast Fingerspitzengefühl im Umgang mit Schüler:innen. Dein Ziel ist es, ihnen wirklich zu helfen.

Das bieten wir dir:

-
Attraktive Vergütung: 27 € für 90 Minuten

Flexibilität: Du bestimmst, wann und wie viel du arbeitest – ohne Mindeststunden.

Sinnvolle Tätigkeit: Werde Teil eines Projekts, das wirklich etwas bewegt.

Freie Mitarbeit: Du bist unabhängig und arbeitest eigenverantwortlich.

Kurze Wege: Wir vermitteln Schüler:innen in deiner Nähe.

Interesse?

Telefon/WhatsApp: 0176 64726213

jobs.title: Healthcare Talent Scout (m/w/d) - Remote | Minijob oder selbstständige Tätigkeit | projektbezogen (Personalvermittler/in)
jobs.description:
Hilf dabei, tolle Menschen mit guten Arbeitgebern zusammenzubringen.

Deine Mission
Manchmal beginnt ein erfolgreicher Suchauftrag mit einer einzigen Telefonnummer.
Manchmal mit einem Namen.
Manchmal mit einer Klinik.
Und manchmal nur mit einer vagen Spur.
Genau hier beginnt Deine Mission.

Du hast Spaß daran, den richtigen Ansprechpartner zu finden, denkst kreativ und bleibst auch dann freundlich und lösungsorientiert, wenn der direkte Weg einmal nicht funktioniert.
Du gibst nicht nach dem ersten Anruf auf - weil Du weißt, dass hinter jeder Telefonnummer ein Mensch steckt.

Mit Neugier, Geduld und einer guten Portion Spürsinn findest Du Wege, wo andere längst aufgegeben haben. Fast wie ein Detektiv verbindest Du Hinweise, recherchierst die richtigen Ansprechpartner und öffnest Türen für neue berufliche Perspektiven.
Nicht durch Zufall, sondern weil Du dranbleibst.

Als Healthcare Talent Scout unterstützt Du unser Team dabei, qualifizierte Fach- und Führungskräfte im Gesundheitswesen für konkrete Suchaufträge zu identifizieren und anzusprechen.

Dabei arbeitest Du nicht ins Blaue hinein. Jeder Auftrag ist klar definiert. Du erhältst ein Suchprofil, einen Zielradius und alle Informationen, die Du benötigst, um passende Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten zu identifizieren und den ersten Kontakt herzustellen.

Du führst keine Vertragsverhandlungen und begleitest keine Bewerbungsprozesse. Deine Stärke liegt darin, Türen zu öffnen und Menschen für einen unverbindlichen Austausch mit unserem Recruiting-Team zu gewinnen.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du bearbeitest konkrete Suchaufträge für Ärzte, Therapeuten und medizinische Fachkräfte.
- Du recherchierst geeignete Zielkliniken, Praxen oder Gesundheitseinrichtungen innerhalb eines definierten Suchgebiets.
- Du identifizierst passende Ansprechpartner und findest kreative Wege, mit ihnen ins Gespräch zu kommen.
- Du führst telefonische oder digitale Erstgespräche wertschätzend, sympathisch und professionell.
- Du erkennst Wechselmotivation und Interesse an einer neuen beruflichen Perspektive.
- Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Gesprächstermine für unser Recruiting-Team.
- Du dokumentierst Deine Aktivitäten strukturiert in unserem CRM.

Das zeichnet Dich aus
Wichtiger als ein bestimmter Lebenslauf ist Deine Persönlichkeit.
Du gehst offen und unbefangen auf Menschen zu, hast Freude an Gesprächen und behältst auch dann Deine positive Art, wenn der erste Weg einmal nicht zum Ziel führt.
Du hörst gut zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und findest mit Charme, Geduld und gesundem Menschenverstand oft genau den Weg, den andere übersehen.
Vielleicht bringst Du bereits Erfahrung im Active Sourcing, Recruiting, Vertrieb oder der Personalgewinnung mit.

Vielleicht kennst Du aber auch das Gesundheitswesen aus eigener Berufserfahrung und möchtest Deine Menschenkenntnis in einer neuen Aufgabe einsetzen.
Entscheidend ist für uns, dass Du neugierig bist, eigenverantwortlich arbeitest und Freude daran hast, Chancen zu erkennen.

Das erwartet Dich

- Flexible Zusammenarbeit als Minijob oder auf selbstständiger Basis.
- Remote-Arbeit mit freier Zeiteinteilung.
- Konkrete Suchaufträge mit klaren Briefings statt anonymer Massenansprache.
- Moderne Recruiting- und CRM-Tools.
- Gesprächsleitfäden und persönliche Unterstützung durch unser Team.
- Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander.
- Eine leistungsorientierte Vergütung mit attraktiven Erfolgsbausteinen.

Warum Multicareer?
Wir glauben daran, dass gute Personalvermittlung nicht mit Datenbanken beginnt, sondern mit ehrlichen Gesprächen.

Deshalb suchen wir Menschen mit Spürsinn, Neugier und der Fähigkeit, Türen zu öffnen.
Als Healthcare Talent Scout bist Du der erste wichtige Kontakt in diesem Prozess. Mit Deiner Arbeit entstehen Gespräche, aus denen neue berufliche Perspektiven wachsen können.

Klingt nach einer Aufgabe, die zu Dir passt?
Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Erzähle uns, warum Du glaubst, dass genau Du der richtige Healthcare Talent Scout für Multicareer bist.
Sende Deine Bewerbung oder eine kurze Vorstellung an recruiting@multicareer.de.
