jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Manage customer incidents and service requests submitted through the support platform.
Diagnose issues across Linux environments, bare-metal servers, cloud instances, storage, and networking.
Review logs, system metrics, and monitoring alerts using command-line and remote-access tools.
Resolve problems affecting server availability, performance, configuration, and customer access.
Arrange hardware inspections or component replacements with data-centre personnel.
Refer advanced cases to specialized teams with all relevant diagnostic information.
Provide customers with timely updates and understandable technical explanations.
Record solutions, improve support documentation, and work closely with infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
A minimum of two years in Linux support, system administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a related technical field.
Hands-on experience with Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or similar Linux systems.
Strong terminal skills covering processes, services, users, permissions, packages, logs, and file systems.
Sound knowledge of TCP/IP, IP addressing, routing, DNS, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall basics.
General understanding of server components, disks, RAID configurations, and hardware monitoring.
Familiarity with support-ticket, infrastructure-monitoring, logging, or remote-management solutions.
Independent troubleshooting skills, accuracy, and the ability to handle several cases at once.
Upper-Intermediate English or higher for customer correspondence and technical communication.

jobs.title: Strojárski technici
jobs.description:
Kandidát na túto pozíciu musí mať priame skúsenosti s obsluhou, riadením, kontrolou a optimalizáciou technologických procesov čistenia odpadových vôd vrátane spracovania kalov a prevádzky technologických zariadení v súlade s prevádzkovým poriadkom ČOV.

Súčasťou tejto práce je taktiež:

Pravidelná technická údržba, čistenie a nastavovanie strojnotechnologických zariadení ČOV, odstraňovanie bežných prevádzkových porúch a spolupráca s externými servisnými technikmi.

Sledovanie a dopĺňanie chemikálií a prevádzkových médií potrebných pre plynulý chod ČOV, bezpečné nakladanie s chemickými látkami.

Zabezpečovanie a výkon odborných činností v oblasti ochrany životného prostredia (vodné hospodárstvo, čistenie odpadových vôd, nakladanie s odpadmi, ochrana ovzdušia).

Monitorovanie a vyhodnocovanie kvality odpadových vôd, účinnosti čistenia a technologických ukazovateľov; vedenie evidencie a spracovanie pravidelných hlásení pre úrady a interné potreby.

Sledovanie a hodnotenie environmentálnych aspektov a rizík vyplývajúcich z výroby a návrh opatrení na ich minimalizáciu.

Navrhovanie optimalizačných a technických riešení, spolupráca pri príprave a posudzovaní projektovej dokumentácie.

Poskytovanie odbornej súčinnosti interným oddeleniam, školenie zamestnancov v oblasti environmentálnych požiadaviek a kontrola dodržiavania predpisov na pracovisku.

Zabezpečenie súladu činností spoločnosti s platnou legislatívou.

Mzdové podmienky: 1800 - 2300 EUR/mesiac

Finálna mzda závisí od skúseností a praxe uchádzača. Prítomnostný bonus 100 €, cestovný bonus 2 €/deň.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti stratégie a rozvoja
jobs.description:
Obchod nie je len o predaji. Je o dôvere, vzťahoch a príležitostiach. Do nášho tímu hľadáme človeka, ktorý vie nadväzovať nové kontakty, budovať dlhodobé partnerstvá a hľadá riešenia, ktoré prinášajú spokojnosť klientom aj výsledky spoločnosti. Ak máš obchodného ducha, baví ťa komunikácia a chceš pracovať v prostredí hotelierstva, kongresov a eventov, radi ťa spoznáme. Čo bude tvojou úlohou? - aktívne vyhľadávať nové obchodné príležitosti a získavať nových klientov, - budovať a rozvíjať dlhodobé vzťahy s obchodnými partnermi, - prezentovať hotel a naše služby firemným klientom, agentúram a organizátorom podujatí, - pripravovať obchodné ponuky na mieru a viesť obchodné rokovania, - spolupracovať s jednotlivými oddeleniami hotela pri realizácii podujatí, - sledovať trendy na trhu a prichádzať s novými obchodnými príležitosťami, - podieľať sa na plnení obchodných cieľov a ďalšom rozvoji hotela, - organizovať konferencie, firemné stretnutia, oslavy aj výnimočné eventy.
Výhody:ubytovanie, Prémie 25 percent zo základného platu 1400 €, t.j. do 350 € podľa prémiového poriadku spoločnosti. Štvrťročné odmeny na základe dosiahnutého hospodárskeho výsledku. Čo ponúkame? ✨ Prácu, pri ktorej budeš stretávať zaujímavých ľudí a podieľať sa na realizácii výnimočných podujatí. Okrem toho môžeš očakávať: - stabilné zázemie úspešnej spoločnosti, - motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie vrátane bonusovej zložky, - priestor na vlastnú iniciatívu a realizáciu nápadov, - profesionálny tím, ktorý si navzájom pomáha, - možnosti odborného a kariérneho rastu, - zamestnanecké benefity a zvýhodnené využívanie hotelových služieb, - príjemné pracovné prostredie Prečo práve Kubínska Resorts? Sme Kubínska Resorts – spoločnosť, ktorá zastrešuje tri jedinečné hotely. Každý z nich má svoj charakter, klientelu aj príbehy. Práve preto u nás nezažiješ stereotyp. Jeden deň pripravuješ obchodné stretnutie pre firemnú konferenciu, kongres, ďalší teambuilding či firemnú lyžovačku. Hľadáme človeka, na ktorého sa môžeme spoľahnúť. Obchodný manažér je partnerom nielen našich klientov, ale aj celého tímu. Oceníme zodpovednosť, spoľahlivosť, schopnosť dotiahnuť veci do konca a prirodzený cit pre budovanie dlhodobých vzťahov. Ak si energický, rád komunikuješ, nebojíš sa výziev a baví ťa rozmanitá práca, u nás dostaneš priestor realizovať vlastné nápady, ovplyvňovať obchodné výsledky a byť súčasťou spoločnosti, ktorá sa neustále rozvíja. Nehľadáme len kolegu. Hľadáme človeka, ktorý chce rásť spolu s nami. Ak si sa v tomto opise našiel našla, pošli svoj životopis. Tešíme sa, že sa spoznáme.

•    Reprezentácia a degustácie: Sprevádzanie domácich i zahraničných turistov po vinárstve a odborná prezentácia našich vín v anglickom alebo čínskom jazyku.

jobs.title: Talent Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model:



1) Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business.

2) Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density.

3) People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

4) People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services.



We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement.



This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1) Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies

 - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

 - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

 - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

2) Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.

 - Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners

 - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density.

 - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources.

 - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision.

 - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment.

3) Enable talent density

 - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow.

 - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent

 - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent.

 - Enable our leadership bench.

4) Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects

This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include:

 - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent.

 - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment.

 - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do.

 - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion.

 - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders.




HOW YOU’LL WORK

 - Embedded, not independent: You will work as an extension of strategic People Partner leaders and existing Talent Management team, not as a separate talent silo.

 - Strategic + practical: You can shape philosophy at 10,000 feet and turn it into an executable V1 strategy in a week – not for the purpose of moving fast, but for getting opinions and engagement of the right solution fast.

 - High taste, low ego: You have strong opinions about what great talent work looks like, but you build through partnership and field feedback.

 - Systems-minded: You design for repeatability and leverage, while knowing when to do the unscalable thing first.

 - Business-first: You anchor talent work in company outcomes, not HR activity.

 - AI-native and Notion-powered: You are energized by reimagining how talent work should change when AI can remove manual coordination and amplify judgment. You also understand how Notion can support our initiatives.

 - Path-agnostic: You’re glad to start as an individual contributor and build the case for a team through impact, not title.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives).

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority.

 - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms.

 - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes.

 - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Architecte Systèmes et Virtualisation VMware (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Le consultant devra réaliser un état des lieux du parc de virtualisation existant analyser les usages et fonctionnalités VMware réellement activés recueillir et structurer les besoins des équipes techniques et des métiers comparer les solutions alternatives disponibles sur le marché évaluer leur couverture fonctionnelle, leur maturité et leur capacité à supporter les volumes concernés étudier les possibilités de migration et les contraintes de réversibilité définir les scénarios cibles possibles construire une trajectoire technologique à moyen et long terme piloter ou préparer des preuves de concept animer les différents experts internes synthétiser les conclusions restituer les recommandations aux DSI et aux instances de direction.

Profil recherché

Description du profil :

Le besoin porte sur un Lead Architecte ou Architecte transverse senior , avec une véritable posture de consultant stratégique.

Les compétences indispensables

Les compétences indispensables sont une forte expérience d'architecture VMware une expérience significative sur OpenStack une bonne connaissance des solutions alternatives de virtualisation une expérience des infrastructures à très grande échelle une compréhension des problématiques de datacenter, de réseau, de stockage et de matériel une capacité à raisonner comme un fournisseur de cloud privé une expérience de l'industrialisation et de la mise à disposition rapide de services une capacité à construire et défendre une conviction technologique une excellente aptitude à l'animation, à la synthèse et à la restitution auprès de dirigeants.

Attentes sur la posture

Le candidat ne doit pas être uniquement un administrateur ou un architecte technique spécialisé dans l'exploitation.

Il doit être capable de prendre de la hauteur, d'organiser une étude, d'encadrer les expertises techniques et de produire des recommandations facilitant la prise de décision de la direction.

Dimension de l'environnement

Dimension de l'environnement

jobs.title: Traveler Care Specialist Luxury Travel
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Established in 2008, Zicasso is the most-reviewed and highest-rated luxury travel company, specializing in immersive custom tours, vacations, and safaris. Our Zicasso travel specialists are the worldâs top 2% of boutique tour operators and travel agents, pre-vetted and handpicked to compete in creating itineraries tailored to each of our travelersâ unique preferences. Joining Zicasso, you'll play a key role in bringing our travelersâ dreams to lifeâpushing the boundaries of whatâs possible with luxury travel experiences.

As a member of our team, youâll be part of a company recognized for its strong brand reputation among discerning travelers. Our authority in the luxury travel industry is consistently affirmed through features in top media outlets, including The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, BBC, Forbes, CNN, and CondÃ© Nast Traveler, to name a few. See our press coverage here.

We are a fully remote company spanning five continents, and we foster a dynamic, progressive global work environment that values creativity, initiative, and continuous learning. We're seeking passionate, data-driven individuals who thrive in a high-performance environment and are eager to contribute to our innovative company culture, underpinned by a consistent pursuit of excellence, integrity, and teamwork.

Our global team comes together biannually for international retreats and summits. These are typically held for a week at a new location each time, providing opportunities to share ideas, collaborate in person, and strengthen our culture, all while learning firsthand about the destinations we serve. These events embody our commitment to both professional growth and the transformative power of travel.

Join us in shaping the future of luxury travel while working towards our visionâcreating a more connected humanity through travel. To learn more, visit https://www.zicasso.com/careers.


The Role

Currently, we are seeking a highly motivated, customer service-minded Traveler Care Specialist who embraces an entrepreneurial spirit and has a passion for international travel!

This role will be working at the intersection of our travelers and Zicassoâs global network of travel providers (partners), making both sides delighted with Zicassoâs unique matching service and will be responsible for assessing and processing incoming travel inquiries via email/messaging, phone, and online. You will learn to understand analytics and help ensure that we are maximizing the potential of our leads. You will build trusted relationships with our travelers to understand their travel needs and ensure these needs are being met and their expectations exceeded. This position plays a key role towards driving loyalty and repeat bookings of our most valued travelers.

This is an international, fully remote, freelance contractor position, working from home with a 5-day workweek that includes rotating weekend shifts. Initial training (3 to 4 weeks) will take place Monday through Friday.Â 

This role is open to candidates located outside of the United States, with a strong preference for those based in Argentina, Costa Rica, Brazil, and Colombia.

The work will all be conducted in English.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide exceptional customer service to travelers by taking ownership of their inquiries and becoming a trusted advisor throughout their use of Zicasso services. This includes assessing and solving incoming traveler inquiries via phone, live chat, messages and email.
  • Build trusted, long-lasting relationships with discerning luxury clients to strengthen their confidence in Zicasso. This involves assisting and serving clients in a way that meets their needs and exceeds their expectations.
  • Ensure a high level of inquiry conversion by demonstrating expertise in consultation, product knowledge, and the benefits of using Zicasso. This includes speaking with travelers via phone calls (and sometimes video), helping them understand how Zicasso works, and providing guidance for their travel needs.
  • Participate cross-functionally with the Partnerships, Product, and Marketing teams to integrate best practices and solutions for the client's experience and/or issues that may arise.
  • Partner with the Care Team leadership on projects and initiatives to solve problems and create innovative solutions.
  • Leverage Zicassoâs data, analytics and technologyÂ  to set new standards for customer success, driving innovation and excellence for the luxury travel industry.
  • Provide consultation and advice to move general inquiries to destination-specific trip requests.
  • Coach and mentor team members as needed.

Please Note: Weâre seeking highly-motivated candidates. Those who excel in this role will be given the opportunity to take on increasingly complex projects and initiatives, and grow their role and responsibility within the Traveler Care Team.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in the travel industry, with a focus on travel sales or operations of luxury tours or hotels. Examples of relevant experience include tour leader, tour director, hotel front desk, client relations, or guest services
  • Passionate about travel, with extensive experience traveling abroad and a strong curiosity about new international destinations.
  • Strong customer service-focused skills, with a passion for building strong relationships with travelers. This includes being comfortable with telephone-based work as a key part of the role.
  • Excellent fluency in oral and written English.
  • A cheerful and confident person who is adaptable to different styles of communication and traveler behaviors.
  • Highly motivated and enthusiastic, with a willingness to put in extra effort in a start-up environment to drive company success.
  • Comfortable with technology and able to quickly learn and adapt to the use of new software. Thorough knowledge of Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) (e.g. Docs, Sheets, Slides) is preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, striving to achieve quality, error-free work.
  • Work flexible hours, including weekends, evenings, and holidays.
  • A Bachelor's degree or higher is preferred.


What We Offer:

  • Remote work from your home base and flexible hours that allow you to enjoy a great work-life balance.
  • Innovative, fast-paced and collaborative culture that values diverse voices and opinions.
  • Learning and development annual stipend.
  • Enjoy two company-sponsored business trips each year at international destinations we serve!

If you are a customer service-minded problem solver with a passion for travel and a strong desire to make a difference, we strongly encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to join our team and help shape the future of personalized, life-enriching travel experiences at Zicasso!

All applications should be submitted in English.


Our Commitment to Candidates

Zicasso is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicable to all locations, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities; if you need an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact careers@zicasso.com.

At Zicasso, we value a highly personalized recruitment journey. For recruiting purposes, we may use AI tools to review, transcribe, and record application materials and interviews, but this is always under human review and judgment. All final hiring determinations are made exclusively by our hiring teams.

jobs.title: Assurance qualité (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Location: Gémenos, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.

Nos engagements, vos avantages***Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée***Un package de rémunération attractif***Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes***Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs***Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Gémenos, vous intégrez un site localisé entre mer et collines provençales, regroupant nos activités d'identité et de sécurité numériques et nos activités de défense alliant à la fois ingénierie et production, et favorisant un environnement de travail collaboratif et convivial.

Au sein de l'équipe Qualité Offres et Projets, vous contribuez à sécuriser les offres stratégiques et à garantir leur faisabilité technique, opérationnelle et financière avant leur contractualisation.

En tant que Bid Quality Assurance Manager, vous serez en charge de Évaluer la conformité des offres en vérifiant l'application des processus, procédures et bonnes pratiques qualité tout au long de la phase d'avant-vente.***Analyser les risques qualité, techniques, opérationnels et organisationnels afin d'anticiper les impacts potentiels sur l'exécution future des projets et proposer des plans d'actions adaptés.***Accompagner les équipes offres dans l'identification des écarts, la résolution des problématiques et la mise en œuvre des actions préventives et correctives nécessaires à la sécurisation des propositions commerciales.***Contrôler la prise en compte et la bonne gestion des exigences clients, qu'elles soient techniques, contractuelles ou organisationnelles, par l'ensemble des contributeurs de l'offre.***Vérifier la qualité, la cohérence et l'exhaustivité de la documentation produite afin de garantir une transition efficace entre la phase d'offre et la phase projet.***Conseiller la Direction et les parties prenantes en produisant des analyses objectives sur les risques identifiés, tout en contribuant au développement des compétences des équipes grâce à des actions de coaching, de mentorat et de partage des bonnes pratiques.

Votre profil

- Votre priorité est de sécuriser des offres complexes et stratégiques tout en maîtrisant les risques associés Vous avez l'ambition d'accompagner des équipes multidisciplinaires dans l'amélioration continue de leurs pratiques qualité Vous avez envie de contribuer à des projets d'envergure internationale au sein d'un environnement technologique exigeant ?

Vous disposez d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur en génie logiciel, informatique ou domaine équivalent et justifiez de plus de 15 années d'expérience dans les domaines techniques, la gestion d'offres et/ou la gestion de projets sur Les processus, méthodes et outils d'assurance qualité La gestion d'offres, la gestion de projets et les activités d'achats Le développement logiciel, les tests, la validation et l'intégration de systèmes Les référentiels qualité, notamment la norme ISO 9001.

La maîtrise courante de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, est indispensable pour ce poste.

Le leadership, la capacité d'analyse, le sens de l'organisation et l'aptitude à fédérer des équipes autour d'objectifs communs sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnaît ?

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

jobs.title: Project Administrator
jobs.description:
Bavarian Capital is adding a Project Administrator to support our ongoing coordination efforts for a major engagement with a leading Spanish telecommunications provider. This role ensures that our internal processes remain organized and that project timelines are managed with the precision our partners expect. By focusing on administrative clarity, you help maintain the high standards of documentation and scheduling that define our firm.

About the role
 As a Project Administrator, you will serve as a central point of coordination for the team, handling the logistical and administrative tasks that keep our projects moving forward. You will work closely with project leads to track progress, update documentation, and facilitate clear communication across different workstreams. This is an entry level position designed for someone who is highly organized and wants to start a career in project management within a professional investment firm. The role is fully remote, requiring a professional who can manage their tasks independently while staying connected with a distributed team.

What you will do
  • Maintain and update project schedules to ensure all milestones are recorded and visible to the team.
  • Organize and manage digital files and documentation related to the Spanish telecommunications engagement.
  • Prepare regular status reports that summarize project progress for internal reviews and meetings.
  • Coordinate internal meetings and ensure that all participants have the necessary materials and agendas beforehand.
  • Track project expenses and administrative tasks to assist with budget oversight and record keeping.
  • Assist with the drafting of internal updates to keep all team members informed of project developments.
  • Monitor project timelines to identify any potential delays early in the process and report them to leads.
  • Update internal databases and project management tools to reflect the most current information.


What we are looking for
  • A background in business administration, management, or a related field of study.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple administrative tasks simultaneously.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Basic familiarity with standard project management tools and documentation software.
  • A methodical approach to work with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
  • The ability to work effectively and independently in a fully remote environment.
  • A reliable and professional attitude toward meeting deadlines and following internal instructions.
  • Proficiency in standard office applications for documentation, data entry, and scheduling.


What we offer
  • A permanent, full-time position within a stable and respected investment firm.
  • A fully remote working arrangement that supports professional autonomy and focus.
  • Competitive pay that reflects the responsibilities of the role and the current market.
  • Opportunities for professional development and learning within the project management field.
  • A professional home where your contributions to project efficiency are recognized.
  • Access to modern tools and systems that support reliable remote collaboration.
  • A calm and focused working environment free from the distractions of a traditional office.
  • The chance to work on large scale projects with significant international partners.


Working at Bavarian Capital
 Bavarian Capital is built on a foundation of reliability and long term thinking. We avoid the frantic pace often found in the investment sector, preferring instead to move with purpose and precision. This approach extends to how we manage our team, offering a high degree of professional autonomy and a clear, remote first structure. We believe that by providing a stable and respectful environment, our team members can focus on their craft and produce their best work. This role is a chance to start a career in an organization that values clarity, thoughtful decision making, and the sustainable growth of its people and its projects. We prioritize steady progress over short term trends, ensuring that every member of our team has a reliable and predictable path forward.

durability, protection, and versatility. With leading market positions across construction, protective apparel, medical packaging,

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply
Online application should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to the Dean, Katalin Ligeti
• CV, including periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Statement of future research, teaching and other activities (max 5 pages)
• Short description of the three most important scholarly achievements (max. 2 pages)
• List of publications, research projects acquired, and PhD theses supervised (if applicable)
• List of teaching activities
• Copy of the PhD diploma
• The names, contact information and present position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by of 29/04/2026.

jobs.title: CFO HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (m/f)
jobs.description:
CFO HSBC Investment Funds (Luxembourg) S.A.

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our Asset Management business.

What you will do:

Reporting functionally to the Asset Management Continental Europe CFO and locally to the CEO of HSBC Investment Funds Luxembourg (HIFL), you will head the Finance function for HIFL, the HIFL Ireland Branch and the HIFL UAE Branch. You will ensure consistently high standards of financial control, reporting and executive insight. You will be a key member of the HIFL Local Management Committee and a standing attendee at key governance forums, presenting the HIFL's financial position to senior stakeholders.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Head the Finance function across HIFL Luxembourg, HIFL Ireland Branch and HIFL UAE Branch, setting a high bar for financial control, reporting quality and decision support for executive stakeholders.
• Deliver accurate, timely and compliant Group reporting, producing clear, executive-ready MI and ad hoc insight for stakeholders including the AMEU CFO.
• Own end-to-end statutory reporting: prepare IFRS financial statements aligned to Asset Management standards and maintain strong ledger integrity, including oversight of postings to the HIFL ledger.
• Direct the audit cycle end-to-end, coordinating auditors to meet all deliverables on time and to a high standard.
• Drive a robust balance sheet and cost base: ensure reconciliations are complete and well-evidenced; oversee operational budgets for fund ranges; maintain accurate accruals and invoice governance, keeping forecasts aligned to business changes.
• Provide effective financial stewardship and risk oversight: submit local regulatory returns; validate management fee calculations and intercompany payaways to ensure fair revenue allocation across AMG sites; act as TPEM and/or Risk Steward for suppliers where applicable.

You should apply if you have:

• Relevant professional accountancy qualification (e.g., ACA / ACCA / CA / CPA or equivalent).
• Strong experience in asset management, financial services, audit and/or private wealth management, with senior accountability for financial control and reporting.
• Deep knowledge of IFRS and financial statement preparation. Knowledge of Lux GAAP and Luxembourg regulatory reporting requirements is an advantage.
• Strong leadership capability, including oversight of offshore/outsourced teams and delivery through a matrix environment.
• Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical matters to non-specialists and senior stakeholders.
• Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 116,900 – 140,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers  

Discover how ‘We Value Difference'.

• For this purpose, management and oversight of external service providers and managed service providers, including monitoring and KPI reporting
• Management and governance of external service providers and managed service providers supporting both on-premises and cloud environments, including monitoring, SLA compliance, KPI tracking, and reporting
• Continuous improvement of incidents, problems, and change management processes across the hybrid infrastructure ecosystem, aligned with security, resilience, and compliance requirements
• Planning and management of the hybrid transformation roadmap, including migration from on-premises systems to cloud or SaaS platforms, as well as optimization of existing hybrid architectures
• Development of infrastructure roadmaps, annual planning, and budgeting, aligned with the overall IT strategy and hybrid cloud adoption strategy
• Evaluation, selection, and introduction of new technologies to improve resilience, scalability, efficiency, and security across hybrid environments
• Technical and disciplinary leadership, as well as further development of a high-performing infrastructure team with hybrid cloud capabilities
• Ensuring regulatory, security, and data protection compliance (including DORA, GDPR) across all hybrid infrastructure components
• Supporting internal and external audits and implementing corrective measures, including requirements from frameworks such as ISO 27001

Profile:

• 7–12 years of professional experience in IT infrastructure - ideally in the financial industry or at an IT service provider serving the financial industry with strong exposure to hybrid environments (on-premises and cloud)
• Solid, demonstrable experience managing hybrid IT infrastructures, including virtualization, cloud platforms (private/public), networking, and enterprise workplace systems
• Strong knowledge of modern workplace environments, particularly Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure integration
• Deep understanding of infrastructure security and cybersecurity practices in hybrid and cloud environments
• Process-oriented approach, solid experience with IT service management frameworks, preferably ITIL
• Proven experience leading and developing a team of approximately six IT professionals, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Strong interest in and understanding of 2nd-level application support and application maintenance activities, ensuring effective incident resolution, root cause analysis, and close collaboration with business and development teams.
• Fluent in English and French, written and spoken (C1/C2 level required)
• Structured, reliable, and solution-oriented approach to work
• Experience in cloud migration or infrastructure transformation projects, as well as with ISO 27001, DORA and GDPR requirements and audits, is desirable

Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting

• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and environment we live in.
The Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) is dedicated to advancing health and improving quality of life through excellence in research, education, and clinical engagement. Responsive to national health priorities and connected to international networks, our researchers address major challenges in human health - from fundamental discoveries to professional practice. The University of Luxembourg has set a strategic focus on medicine and health and is actively developing the training and research areas in these domains, creating exceptional opportunities in medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The successful candidate will contribute to the strategic development and continuous advancement of the University's Medical Specialisation Programmes. The candidate will assist Directors of Studies in developing research ideas, preparing competitive project proposals and funding applications, analysing scientific and educational developments, and translating research outcomes into programme enhancement and innovation. The candidate will work closely with the Directors of Studies, academic and administrative staff, as well as other internal and external institutional stakeholders.
Main responsibilities:
• Support the Directors of Studies in the development, coordination, and continuous improvement of the Medical Specialisation Programmes through research-informed educational initiatives
• Support curriculum development and the implementation of innovative educational approaches, such as simulation, digital learning and artificial intelligence, patient partnership
• Identify national and international funding opportunities and support the preparation of educational research proposals, grant applications, and collaborative project submissions
• Conduct literature reviews, environmental scans, benchmarking studies, and scientific analyses to inform strategic programme development
• Develop and implement programme evaluation strategies, analyse educational outcomes and generate evidence to support continuous quality improvement
• Contribute to scientific publications, reports, conference presentations, and other dissemination activities
• Monitor developments in healthcare, specialist medical training, research funding, healthcare policy, and relevant regulatory frameworks
• Support quality assurance, programme evaluation and accreditation processes of the Medical Specialisation Programmes
• Foster collaboration with national and international academic institutions, healthcare providers, professional organisations, and research networks

Your profile
• Master's degree in Medicine, Health Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Medical Education, Public Health, Healthcare Management, Education, or another relevant discipline
• 5+ years of experience working in medical education, health sciences, clinical research, or a healthcare environment would be a strong asset
• Experience in research project development, grant writing, project coordination, or higher education administration
• Demonstrated ability to prepare research proposals, funding applications, or strategic project documentation
• Strong analytical skills with experience in literature reviews, data analysis, and evidence synthesis
• Excellent scientific writing, reporting, and communication skills
• Ability to collaborate effectively with academic and administrative stakeholders
Language Requirements: Excellent command (C1) of English and French, and very good command (B2) of German or Luxembourgish is an asset.
Diversity and Gender Equality: The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Computer Science (DCS) conducts cutting-edge research and offers high-quality education in core areas of computer science, with particular strengths in artificial intelligence, information security, and advanced computing systems. DCS promotes interdisciplinary research and closely cooperates with other high-profile research centers in Luxembourg and beyond, as well as with industry and society. The faculty entertains various successful and growing teaching programs and supports lifelong learning activities.

Your role
As a professor in the Department of Computer Science, you will:
• Lead research in your area of expertise, with a focus on machine learning and foundation models, and have the opportunity to establish and grow your own research group within a collaborative environment
• Collaborate actively with colleagues across the department, the university, and national research institutions, benefiting from Luxembourg's dynamic and well-funded research ecosystem
• Contribute to teaching at all levels - e.g.: Bachelor, Master, and Doctoral -, designing and delivering courses in your field of expertise
• Supervise and mentor PhD and postdoctoral researchers, and support their development through seminars and related activities
• Participate in shaping the department's research and educational agenda

For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Jean-Sébastien Coron, Head of the Department of Computer Science, Email: jean-sebastien.coron@uni.lu


Your profile
The Faculty of Science, Technology, and Medicine (FSTM) seeks a candidate with:
• A PhD degree in Computer Science or a closely related field
• A research track record in Artificial Intelligence, with an emphasis on machine learning and an openness to interdisciplinary collaboration — both within academia and with industry partners
• Expertise in one or more core areas of machine learning and foundation models, such as deep learning, representation learning, probabilistic modeling, reinforcement learning, optimization for learning, trustworthy and efficient machine learning, or foundation models including large language and multimodal models. We particularly value depth of knowledge, originality, and the potential for cross-disciplinary innovation
• Publications in top-tier computer conferences and journals related to AI and machine learning, including but not limited to NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, JMLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, IJCV, TPAMI, ACL, EMNLP, KDD, AAAI, IJCAI, ECAI, COLT, UAI, AAMAS, AISTATS, TACL, SIGIR, WSDM, Web Conference
• Experience in teaching Computer Science topics at undergraduate, graduate, or postgraduate levels and willingness to contribute to the department's teaching and administrative missions

Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English. Proficiency in French or German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:

• Curriculum Vitae; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience

• Statement of planned research, teaching and other activities at the University of Luxembourg (1–3 pages)
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects
• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
We encourage early application. Applications are only accepted online through the HR system. The position will be unposted on 30th September 2026, after which no further applications can be submitted. Applications will be handled in strict confidence.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa

u Zavodu za javno zdravstvo Krapinsko – zagorske županije za radno mjesto

  • Voditelj/ica Odsjeka za tehničke poslove i zaštitu na radu - 1 izvršitelj/ica na neodređeno vrijeme

Uz pisanu prijavu na natječaj kandidati su dužni priložiti:

  • životopis,

  • dokaz o najmanje četiri godine radnog iskustva u struci – presliku ugovora o radu i/ili potvrdu poslodavca koja mora sadržavati vrstu poslova i razdoblje njihovog obavljanja,
  • presliku vozačke dozvole „B“ kategorije.

Sukladno članku 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN br. 82/08 i 69/17), na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe obaju spolova pod jednakim uvjetima.

Riječi i pojmovi u tekstu natječaja koji imaju rodno značenje, bez obzira na to jesu li korišteni u muškom ili ženskom rodu, odnose se na jednak način na muški i na ženski rod.

U prijavi kandidati trebaju navesti osobne podatke, adresu prebivališta, adresu elektroničke pošte za primanje pismena te broj telefona na kojem je kandidat dostupan.

Kandidat koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti dokumentaciju o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju, sukladno propisima kojima je to pravo uređeno. Navedeni kandidat prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate ostvaruje samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju članka 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti sve potrebne dokaze prema članku 103. stavku 1. Zakona koji su dostupni na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja na sljedećoj poveznici, te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju članka 48. Zakona о civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN br. 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti sve dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona koji su dostupni su na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja na sljedećoj poveznici, te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba sa invaliditetom (NN br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca.

Prijave na natječaj s prilozima podnose se na e-mail adresu: tajnica@zzjzkzz.hr

Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i poslodavca.

Osoba koja ne podnese pravovremenu i/ili potpunu prijavu ili za koju se utvrdi da ne ispunjava formalne uvjete natječaja neće se smatrati kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj te se takva prijava neće razmatrati.

Kandidati koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja bit će pozvani na razgovor radi provjere stručnih i radnih sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova oglašenog radnog mjesta. O mjestu i vremenu održavanja razgovora kandidati će biti obaviješteni elektroničkom poštom na e-adresu navedenu u prijavi.

Ako kandidat ne pristupi razgovoru, smatrat će se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje privolu Zavodu za javno zdravstvo Krapinsko-zagorske županije da, kao voditelj obrade, podatke prikupljene na temelju ovoga javnoga natječaja obrađuje samo u opsegu i samo u svrhu provedbe natječaja, po osobama ovlaštenim za provedbu natječaja. Zavod će s osobnim podacima postupati sukladno odredbama pozitivnih propisa i općih akata Zavoda kojima se uređuje zaštita osobnih podataka, uz primjenu odgovarajućih tehničkih i organizacijskih mjera zaštite osobnih podataka od neovlaštenog pristupa, zlouporabe, otkrivanja, gubitka ili oštećenja.

O ishodu natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od 8 dana nakon donošenja odluke o odabiru, objavom iste na mrežnim stranicama Zavoda.

jobs.title: SAMOSTALNI REFERENT/SAMOSTALNA REFERENTICA JAVNE NABAVE
jobs.description:
Na temelju Odluke o potrebi zasnivanja radnog odnosa i raspisivanju ponovljenog javnog natječaja broj: 1919/26 od 27. srpnja 2026. godine KD VODOVOD I KANALIZACIJA doo iz Rijeke, Dolac 14 (u daljnjem tekstu: Društvo), objavljuje JAVNI NATJEČAJ za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto Samostalni referent javne nabave u Službi pravnih i općih poslova i javne nabave, Sektor pravnih i zajedničkih poslova, jedan (1) izvršitelj, na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od šest (6) mjeseci. Uvjeti navedenog radnog mjesta:
  • VSS ekonomskog ili pravnog smjera
  • 1 godina radnog iskustva na sličnim ili istim poslovima
  • položen ispit za specijalističku javnu nabavu ili obveza polaganja istog u roku od 6 mjeseci
  • poznavanje rada na osobnom računalu i informatičkih programa
  • poznavanje engleskog jezika
  • položen vozački ispit B kategorije
Opis poslova radnog mjesta:
  • Sudjeluje u procesu priprema i provedbe postupaka javne nabave, provodi postupke javne nabave i izvješćuje o realizaciji provedbe postupaka javne nabave.
  • Postupke provodi temeljem zakonske regulative iz područja javne nabave i zakonske regulative iz ostalih područja, godišnjeg plana Društva i odobrenih ugovora na razini Društva.
  • Surađuje s voditeljem Odjela i rukovoditeljima stručnih službi Društva vezano za pripremu dokumentacije i pribavljanje tehničkih specifikacija za izvođenje radova, isporuku robe ili pružanje usluga koji su predmet javne nabave.
  • Priprema dokumentaciju za nadmetanje, sastavlja objave o javnoj nabavi, sudjeluje kod zaprimanja i otvaranja ponuda za nadmetanje, sastavlja zapisnike i izvješća.
  • Nakon završenog postupka predaje svu dokumentaciju postupka Referentu javne nabave na pohranu i čuvanje.
  • Prati i primjenjuje zakonske i podzakonske propise, aktivnosti i analize stanja iz područja javne nabave.
  • Obavlja ostale stručne i administrativne poslove te druge potrebne radnje u postupcima javne nabave na razini Odjela i po nalogu nadređenih.
Kandidati su, uz prijavu na natječaj, dužni dostaviti:
  • životopis,
  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi (presliku diplome),
  • dokaz o radnom iskustvu (e-radna knjižica),
  • dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu za specijalistu javne nabave (ako je ispit položen),
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu o poznavanju rada na računalu,
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu o poznavanju engleskog jezika,
  • presliku vozačke dozvole
  • uvjerenje suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od tri mjeseca).
Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u tekstu natječaja, a imaju rodno značenje, odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (''Narodne novine'' broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja iz članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na sljedećoj poveznici https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-u-drzavnoj-sluzbi/843. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti i dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na sljedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-u-drzavnoj-sluzbi/843. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/8 i 32/20), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta oglasa, dostaviti i dokaz o invalidnosti (javnu ispravu o invalidnosti na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlene osobe s invaliditetom) te akt iz kojeg je vidljiv na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Prijavite se za podnošenje: 1. putem pošte na adresu: KD VODOVOD I KANALIZACIJA doo Rijeka Ured za ljudske resurse Dolac 14 (III kat) 51000 Rijeka ili 2. na e-mail: posao@kdvik-rijeka.hr. Rok za podnošenje prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta iznosi petnaest (15) dana od objave natječaja na Hrvatskom zavodu za zapošljavanje i mrežnoj stranici Društva. Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje prilog za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi na ovaj natječaj, kao i dokumentaciju dostavljenu prijavom, u svrhu izbora kandidata. Prikupljeni osobni podaci obrađivat će se u skladu s propisima odnosno s Uredbom (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine, br. 42/18). Kandidat koji nije podnio pravodobnu i/ili urednu prijavu (sa svojom traženom dokumentacijom) ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja neće se smatrati kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i njegova se prijava neće razmatrati. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja pozivaju se na intervju. Kandidat koji se ne odazove na intervju više se neće smatrati kandidatom u postupku. Odluku o izboru kandidata donosi direktor Društva na temelju postignutih rezultata, u roku od trideset (30) dana od dana isteka roka za podnošenje prijave. Protiv odluke o izboru kandidata ne postoji mogućnost ulaganja pravnog lijeka. O ishodu natječajnog postupka svaki prijavljeni kandidat bit će obaviješten na mrežnim stranicama Društva u roku od osam (8) dana od dana donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata. Društvo se pridržava prava poništenja javnog natječaja u svakoj fazi postupka, bez posebnog obrazloženja i zbog toga ne odgovara za eventualnu štetu.
