jobs.title: 100% Remote Technical Implementation Manager (Hotel PMS / CRS Integration Specialist) EN (Hotelfachmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Hotel Revenue Manager; Hotel Systems Experte

Stellenbeschreibung:
Hotel PMS use Experience Required (please do not apply if you have never used a hotel PMS)

Location: Fully Remote (EU preferred – Spain / Portugal / Southern Europe or global if compatible with EOR or contractor setup)
Employment Type: Full-Time (Flexible Hours)
Experience Level: Experience with hotel systems required
Salary Range: €30.000 - 45.000

Company Overview

Hotel Res Bot is a fast-growing SaaS company building AI-powered automation systems for the hospitality industry.

Our platform automatically reads incoming reservation emails and generates tailored offers for guests.

Unlike many traditional hotel systems, we work entirely with live real-time data from PMS, CRS, IBE, and Channel Manager APIs. Because of this, stable integrations and accurate data flow are critical to our product.

This is where this role comes in.

Job Summary

Are you the person at the hotel everyone turns to when the PMS stops syncing, the channel manager misbehaves, or integrations break?  This can be a great transition role into hotel tech from hotel operations

We are looking for a Hotel Systems Integration Specialist to take ownership of technical connectivity and implementation for our hotel partners.

This role is focused specifically on integration execution and system connectivity. You will work closely with our Account Management and Support teams, but you will not be responsible for commercial account management or first-line customer support. Your primary responsibility is ensuring that integrations between hotel systems and our platform are configured, tested, and functioning reliably.

You will also play an important internal role by helping our developers understand new PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager integrations — translating vendor documentation, operational workflows, and real-world hotel requirements into clear technical specifications and test scenarios.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

Own Technical Onboarding
Lead the technical setup and activation of new hotel clients on our platform.

Ensure Reliable Connectivity
Configure, test, and validate integrations between our system and hotel PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager environments.

Translate Hotel Requirements into Technical Specs
When hotels request specific workflows (e.g. reservation field mapping, folio posting rules, or company profile handling), analyze whether and how their PMS APIs support it.

Work with API Documentation & Testing Tools
Use tools like Postman to test API endpoints, validate responses, and confirm system behavior before implementation.

Bridge to Engineering
Translate integration findings into clear, actionable specifications and GitLab tickets for the engineering team.

Troubleshoot Integration Issues
Investigate and resolve connectivity problems such as synchronization errors, missing reservation data, or incorrect folio postings.

Guide Hotel Technical Teams
Support hotel IT, revenue, or operations teams through setup steps such as API authentication (e.g. Microsoft Graph) and simple DNS configuration (e.g. CNAME records).

What We Are Looking For

Must Have

Experience with Hotel Systems Required
Previous experience working with hotel systems (such as PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, or other hotel operations platforms) is required.

Interface (API) Curiosity & Documentation Skills
Ability to read and interpret API documentation and figure out how to validate behavior using tools like Postman.

Technical Comfort (No Coding Required)
Comfort working with structured data (JSON/XML), basic API concepts, and technical troubleshooting workflows.

Strong Communication Skills
Ability to communicate clearly with both hotel operational teams and technical stakeholders.

Problem-Solving Mindset
You enjoy investigating why systems don’t work and prefer practical solutions over theoretical perfection.

Fluent English
Written and spoken.  No German required.

Nice to Have (We Can Teach You)

- Experience using Postman for API testing
- Basic understanding of DNS / CNAME configuration
- Experience with PMS vendors such as Mews, Opera, Cloudbeds, Protel, SiteMinder, D-EDGE, SynXis, or Apaleo
- Previous experience in hotel tech (PMS, Channel Manager, CRS, IBE vendors)

What Success Looks Like

Within 6 weeks, you will be independently:

- Onboarding and configuring hotel system integrations
- Testing API endpoints and validating integration behavior
- Translating hotel requirements into clear technical specifications
- Creating actionable engineering tickets for integration work
- Supporting live troubleshooting of connectivity issues

Culture & Working Style

We are a fully remote, international team operating in a trust-based environment.

We value:

- Remote & flexibility first – work from anywhere, structure your day how it works best for you
- High autonomy with high responsibility – you own your work end-to-end
- Strong error culture – mistakes are expected as part of learning; we focus on fixing and improving, not blaming
- Respectful communication – direct feedback is welcome, personal attacks are not
- Pragmatism over perfection – we prefer working systems over theoretical perfection

We work in a fast-moving environment where clarity improves over time through iteration, not upfront perfection.

Benefits

- Fully remote position
- Flexible working hours
- Direct access to engineering and product teams
- High autonomy and ownership
- Opportunity to grow into technical product or engineering roles
- Equipment provided (laptop + accessories if needed)

How to Apply

Please send your application to: career@hotelresbot.com

Please include:

- CV or short professional background
- Brief cover letter explaining: - Your experience with hotel systems (PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, etc.)
- Your comfort level with reading API documentation and using tools like Postman
- Why you are interested in hotel SaaS implementation and connectivity

Ergänzende Informationen:
Homeoffice:
Umfang: Maximal 100%
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Datenaustauschformat JSON, Tourismusplattformen und Buchungssysteme
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Hotelverwaltungs-, Reservierungssystem Opera, Reservierung (Hotel- und Gaststättengewerbe)

Seoses suvise hooaja ja suurenenud töömahuga otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks või hooajaliseks tööks suveperioodil. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid
* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt.
Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

Tööülesanded: Meie eesmärk on tagada oma klientidele ja partneritele kõige turvalisemad ja eeskujulikumad töömaad Eestis. jobs.title: Ship to Shore Technician
jobs.description:
Job Description

As a Ship-to-Shore Technician, you will play a vital role in supporting the safe and efficient operation of vessels arriving and departing at the port. This position involves working on the dock to ensure the proper mooring, securing, and release of ships, while maintaining safety and operational standards. In addition to mooring responsibilities, the role will also involve performing general maintenance and support tasks as required to ensure overall port and equipment readiness.

The Ship-to-Shore Technician is responsible for, but not limited to the following:

Docking and Undocking Operations

  • Assist in safely docking and undocking cruise ships at port using mooring lines, ropes, and related equipment.
  • Work in coordination with the shipâs captain, crew, and port authorities to ensure that vessels are safely secured and aligned with docking infrastructure.

Mooring Line Management:

  • Handle and manage mooring lines, ensuring they are properly fastened, tense, and released.
  • Perform visual inspection of mooring lines and related equipment regularly for wear and damage, ensuring everything is in safe working condition. (Regularly performed by ship crew)

Ship and Dock Safety

  • Maintain safety protocols during mooring procedures, ensuring that all tasks are performed in accordance with safety regulations.
  • Monitor weather conditions and report any changes that could affect docking or undocking procedures.

Communication and Coordination

  • Communicate effectively with other team members on board and shore-based personnel.
  • Work with the Port Authorities to ensure the timely and safe transfer of passengers and cargo.

Emergency Procedures

  • Be trained to respond in case of an emergency during docking or undocking operations, including accidents or hazardous situations.
  • Ensure all mooring operations are conducted efficiently and safely, even under adverse weather conditions or emergencies.

PPE Equipment (MANDATORY)

  • Must always be in possession of steel toe boots (or prescribed non-slip safety shoes), safety vest, hard hat, gloves, radio/communication device. (To be provided by Carnival)

Cleaning & Maintenance of Pier & Mooring Equipment & Fixtures:

  • Ensure all mooring equipment such as winches, ropes, and fenders are properly maintained and operational (through visual checks and inspections).
  • Gangway Inspections & Maintenance: Inspect gangway components for wear, corrosion, proper tension, secure connections, and smooth operation to ensure safe pedestrian access and functionality.
  • Fenders: Conduct visual inspections of pier fenders and associated hardware to identify cracks, deformation, excessive wear, or damage caused by vessel contact, and report deficiencies as needed.
  • Mooring Bollards: Regularly inspect mooring bollards for structural integrity, including corrosion, cracks, loose anchor bolts, foundation stress, and coating condition, to ensure safe vessel mooring.
  • Stanchions & Pier Fixtures: Inspect stanchions and associated components for corrosion, damage, misalignment, or instability, ensuring they remain secure and serviceable.
  • Ropes: Inspect ropes for wear, fraying, or damage, and verify they are properly positioned and suitable for continued use.
  • Mooring Equipment Maintenance: Perform minor maintenance and repairs of mooring equipment when necessary.
  • Pier & Dock Cleaning: Maintain clean, safe, and non-slip pier surfaces by removing dirt, salt, algae, stains, debris and other buildup by pressure washing and using prescribed cleaning equipment and solutions, along all designated cruise pier and trestle areas.
  • Cleaning Equipment Operation: Safely inspect, operate, and maintain cleaning equipment, including scrubbers and pressure washers, ensuring proper use, cleaning, and storage after each operation.

Additional Maintenance Support Activities

  • Perform minor maintenance support to technical teams including plumbing, electrical, masonry, carpentry, and HVAC functions.

Mandatory Training:

  • Maintain compliance with organizational requirements by attending and participating in all required company training sessions.

Lagoon Care

  • Perform maintenance/inspections of lagoon systems.

Education:

  • Education: High School Diploma.
  • Maintenance knowledge is preferred.
  • Certified Pool Operator (CPO) required within 6 months of employment start.
  • Three to Five years' experience working in a mooring or associated fields.

Essential Experience Required:

Must be physically fit. Must have strong customer service skills. Ability to work in an outdoor environment. Ability to multi-task and think critically. Previous work experience preferred. Prolonged periods standing and working outside. Must be able to lift, up to 50 pounds at times. All island employees must be physically able to participate in emergency lifesaving procedures and drills. Full use/range of motion of arms and legs as well as full visual, verbal and hearing abilities are required to receive and give instructions in the event of an emergency. jobs.title: Program & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the LSPA: The LSP Association (LSPA) is a non-profit association for Massachusetts Licensed Site Professionals (LSPs) and other related environmental practitioners who work on behalf of property owners, operators, and other involved parties to assess and cleanup oil and hazardous materials (OHM) released to the environment. LSPs are licensed by the Commonwealth to oversee this work and, since 1993, over 40,000 contaminated properties have been brought into regulatory compliance.


The LSPA's mission is to support our membership in achieving and maintaining a high standard of practice in the assessment and remediation of contaminated sites in Massachusetts and New England. The LSPA provides technical and educational resources to our membership in the form of programming, networking events, committees, and resources. The LSPA also serves as an advocate to the profession with MassDEP, the LSP Board of Registration, and the state legislature, and as a resource to the public.


Job Description: The Program & Events Coordinator plays a critical role in the success of the LSPA and serves as a primary point of contact for our members, volunteers, and sponsors. This individual is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the association's educational programs and networking events, administering the sponsorship program, and providing customer service support. Success in this position means delivering high-quality member experiences, maintaining strong relationships with volunteers and sponsors, and ensuring the smooth administration of our continuing education program.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously. This individual enjoys working independently while collaborating closely with volunteers, board members, speakers, sponsors, and staff.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Educational Programs: Coordinate, plan, and manage programs and speakers for all LSPA courses, membership meetings, emerging professional events, the Annual Fall Party, and the Environmental Symposium. The LSPA hosts one to three events per month with 25-250 people in attendance. Approximately 65% of programming is hosted virtually. Content creation is performed in conjunction with input from the Executive Director, Committee Chairs, Education Committee, and Board of Directors.
  • Event Logistics: For in-person events, source event venues and help facilitate contracts; plan food and beverage, room set-up, and audiovisual needs; reconcile venue bills; and serve as the point of contact on-site. For virtual programs, setup and run the virtual meeting platform, monitor attendance and engagement, create moderator scripts and slides, and train speakers on how to use the virtual platform.
  • Continuing Education (CE) Administration: Compile CE materials for all educational courses and meetings; submit materials for credit approval with the LSP Board of Registration, the Connecticut Licensed Environmental Professional (LEP) Board, and other Boards/entities; maintain CE records related to attendance, engagement, and evaluation; issue certificates of attendance to attendees; and attend monthly virtual LSP Board of Registration meetings.
  • Sponsorship: Help administer the corporate and event sponsorship program, including updating the sponsorship prospectus, facilitating invoices/payments, maintaining contact lists, conducting outreach, and working with sponsors to access their sponsorship benefits.
  • Member Service and Organizational Support: Help monitor and respond to inquiries received through the organization email inbox; provide customer service to members, sponsors, speakers, and event attendees; attend Board meetings, leadership meetings, and committee meetings as requested; and support association operations and special projects as needed.


Qualifications

The person hired for this role should have the following qualifications:


Experience:

  • 2-5 years of experience in program/event planning, project management, or another related field.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and proven ability to provide excellent customer service.
  • Strong project management skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines independently.
  • Comfortable coordinating, building relationships with, and communicating professionally with members, volunteers, sponsors, vendors, and other external stakeholders/partners.


Technology:

  • Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Zoom Meetings and Zoom Webinar, including coordinating presenters from multiple locations, incorporating polling, and managing technical issues.
  • Association management systems (AMS) or member databases.
  • Online registration and evaluation platforms.
  • Canva or similar design tools (preferred, not required).

Preferred Qualifications (not required):

  • Experience working for a nonprofit organization, professional association, or membership-based organization.
  • Experience with the environmental sciences industry.
  • Familiarity with sponsorship development or relationship management.
  • Bachelor's degree, Associate's degree with relevant experience, or significant relevant professional experience demonstrating the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the position successfully.

Why Join the LSPA?

This is an opportunity to work with a respected association that supports environmental professionals making a meaningful impact on public health and environmental protection throughout Massachusetts and New England. As a small organization, we offer autonomy, flexibility, and the opportunity to build relationships with industry leaders while helping shape the educational and professional development experiences of our members. Compensation and benefits include:

  • Salary: The salary range for this position is $70,000â$80,000 annually. Compensation will be based on a variety of factors such as individual qualifications and experience.
  • Benefits: LSPA employees receive $300 per month for a Healthcare Reimbursement Account (HRA) that may be used to reimburse certain medical and insurance-related expenses. The organization does not currently offer group health or dental insurance plans. In addition, employees have access to a 401(k) plan.
  • PTO: 15 days of paid time off (PTO) annually for the first three years (increases to 20 days thereafter). The LSPA also provides 14 holidays per year (inclusive of 5 floating holidays).
  • Fully remote position: Candidates may reside anywhere in New England, with preference given to Massachusetts-based applicants. Travel to Massachusetts-based programs and events approximately 10â12 times annually is required.
  • Reimbursement for home office expenses: $750 annually.


How to Apply

Please submit a cover letter and resume to mmorris@lspa.org. Applications without cover letters or that request compensation/benefits beyond what we can provide will not be reviewed.


The LSPA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact mmorris@lspa.org.


The LSPA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.title: Houseman
jobs.description:
Company: Ocean Hotels Barbados

SUMMARY: Performs a combination of tasks to maintain a high standard of cleanliness and orderliness in the hotel. To ensure guest rooms, working areas and the hotelâs premises in general in a clean and orderly manner.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Operates in full compliance with the AAA 5 Diamond standards.
  • Cleans and sanitized rugs, carpets, and upholstered furniture - using vacuum cleaner, broom, as necessary.
  • Washes walls, ceilings, steps, patios, walkways, doors and window screens of the hotel rooms and public areas. Moves and arranges furniture, turns mattresses, hangs or removes fixtures, ornaments or pictures in guest rooms and offices as required.
  • Sweeps, mops, scrubs, sanitized, waxes, and polishes floors and immediate surroundings including lounge cushions.
  • Sweeps and scrubs corridors in front of guest rooms, removing any bottles.
  • Assists the Room Attendants in labour intensive tasks such as, flipping mattresses, hanging pictures and moving furniture or debris.
  • Make sure that outside areas such as patios and corridors are kept clean, sanitized, tidy and in working order.
  • Dusts and polishes metal work with Quimplex, (where applicable).
  • Collects soiled laundry for laundering, count dirty linen for collection, (where applicable).
  • Stores linen/literature supplies in service area closets.
  • Deliver clean linen or requested items to Room Attendants, (where applicable).
  • Clean, sanitized and polish elevator as often as possible
  • Assists with fixing of drapes etc.
  • Clean and sanitized linen chute, (where applicable).
  • Perform the specified duties at any of the properties of the Ocean Hotels Group.
  • Assist in any area that falls within your division. Perform any ancillary and / or related duties as may be assigned by Management.
  • Clean and sanitized gym daily including equipment; remove dirty towels and garbage, replenish water and clean towels, (where applicable).
  • Cleans ceiling fans, mirrors and glass doors, shower doors, lighting fixtures in rooms and public areas.
  • Cleans all directional signs, linen closet, electrical and exit doors of all corridors.
  • Attends daily briefings, departmental or other meetings as required.
  • Adheres to Company policies, standards and procedures, including Health and Safety, Fire Prevention, Hygiene and Discipline.
  • Attends training courses as agreed with Management, Human Resources Department or your Supervisor.
  • Assists in the lifting of heavy items in excess of 30lbs.
  • In addition to the duties which this job normally entails, you will be required to be completely flexible in this position and must be prepared to undertake such other work as may be assigned to you by the Company from time to time. Such work can be done outside the area of your normal duties.
  • This job description will be amended from time to time. You will be notified of such amendments in writing and your job description will be held to have been automatically updated. A new job description will be issued at the appropriate time.

Knowledge, Skills And Personal Attributes

Knowledge

The Houseman must have proficient knowledge in the following areas:

  • Understand, speak, read and write English at CXC level or equivalent
  • Level 2 or above National Vocational Qualification in Housekeeping

Skills

The Houseman must demonstrate the following skills:

  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Time management skills
  • Read and write English fluently
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time
  • Must be neat, professional and well groomed
  • Must be able to lift up to 20 pounds (lifting above the shoulder is also required)
  • Ability to relate well to hotel guests and employees
  • Ability to understand and carry out oral and written instructions and request clarification when needed
  • A positive attitude and outgoing personality are essential
  • Must be able to work shifts (days, evenings, weekends, holidays and overtime)

Personal Attributes

The Houseman must demonstrate the following personal attributes

  • Hospitality
  • Creativity
  • Reliability
  • Compatibility
  • Effective follow up
  • Flexibility
  • Consistency
  • Professional deportment

jobs.description:
**Etsimme tiimiimme ammattitaitoista, oma-aloitteista ja reipasta autonasentajaa kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen!** Alkuun etsimme **kahta asentajaa**, ja myöhemmin hakusessa on vielä yksi henkilö lisää.

Meillä pääset osaksi hyvää nuorekasta työporukkaa ja saat käyttöösi laadukkaat työkalut, nostimet, diagnostiikkalaitteet ym. Etsimme tekijää, jolla on asenne kohdallaan, hyvät tiimityötaidot ja halu tarttua monipuolisesti kaikkiin korjaamon töihin.

- kaikki autoasentajan työt (mukaan lukien mm. määräaikaishuollot, jakopää- ja kytkinremontit, moottorinvaihdot, rengastyöt, alusta- ja jarruremontit, automaattivaihteiston öljynvaihdot sekä diagnostiikan jne). Toinen paikka voidaan täyttää myös perushuoltoihin ja alustatoimiin keskittyvällä tekijällä.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Kokemusta alan töistä ja B-ajokorttia.

- Reipasta otetta työhön ja kykyä työskennellä osana porukkaa.


**Isoa plussaa antavat:**

- Osaaminen ja kokemus sähkövianhausta.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
About the role We are seeking a Mechanical Technician to join our team supporting underground mining operations in Navan, Ireland. Working as part of a small, highly collaborative maintenance team, you will be responsible for maintaining, servicing, troubleshooting, and repairing bulk explosives pumping systems and associated equipment used in underground mining environments. This is a hands-on role that requires a strong mechanical background, a proactive attitude, and the ability to work independently in a safety-critical environment. While the primary focus is mechanical maintenance, knowledge of electrical systems, PLCs, and industrial controls would be highly advantageous. The successful candidate will play a critical role in supporting equipment reliability, operational uptime, and safe production outcomes while working closely with operational and maintenance stakeholders underground. What you will be doing Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair bulk explosives pumping equipment and associated mechanical systems used in underground mining operations. Perform preventative and corrective maintenance activities to maximise equipment reliability and availability. Diagnose and resolve mechanical faults, supporting operational continuity and minimising downtime. Assist in identifying and resolving electrical and PLC-related issues where required, collaborating with specialist support teams as necessary. Support maintenance planning and execution activities to ensure safe and efficient operations. Participate in on-call rotations and respond to maintenance call-outs outside standard working hours when required. Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation. Work collaboratively across site functions, supporting operational requirements beyond core trade responsibilities when needed. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with all Safety, Health, Environment and Security (SHES) standards, policies, and procedures. Align all activities with Orica’s Charter Values, Purpose, and Strategy. What you will bring Relevant trade qualification, diploma, degree, or equivalent experience in Mechanical Maintenance or a related discipline. Experience working in industrial, mining, heavy equipment, maintenance, or similar environments. Experience maintaining pumps, hydraulic systems, rotating equipment, or similar mechanical systems. Previous underground mining experience is strongly preferred. Knowledge of electrical systems, industrial controls, or PLCs would be highly advantageous. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a practical, hands-on approach. Ability to work independently and safely in a remote operational environment. Strong work ethic and willingness to contribute across multiple operational activities. Effective communication and collaboration skills. This role requires participation in an on-call roster, including out-of-hours and weekend call-outs.

jobs.title: Produktionsmedarbejder søges til specialproduktion
jobs.description:
Har du hænderne godt skruet på og har lyst til at være med til at fremtille kvalitetsprodukter? Og har du lyst til at blive del at et godt hold og en arbejdsplads i udvikling?

Så kom med om bord på Team Plagborg.

Jobbet

Sammen med dine andre kollegaer får du din egen arbejdsplads, med eget værktøj, udstyr og det hele.

Dine opgave bliver at håndbygge dele og halvfabrikata, som bliver en del opbygningen af nye varebiler og lastbiler.

Du er den dygtige gør-det-selv håndværkertype, som ud fra en skitse eller en model finder gode kvalitetsløsninger på tekniske og håndværksmæssige opgaver.

Ingen dage er ens, og du arbejder med mange forskellige opgaver og materialer, blandt andet aluminium, stål, plast og befæstelse.

Du bliver en del af et team af gode kollegaer med et godt sammenhold, og vi står klar med et godt fællesskab, åbenhed og humor.

Arbejdet er på daghold.

Din baggrund og erfaring

Du er god til at bruge dine hænder, og du sætter en dyd i at lave delene på den helt rette måde, så det ender med et slutprodukt i den ønskede kvalitet.

Du har teknisk flair, er detaljeorienteret og kvalitetsbevidst, og du har erfaring med håndværktøj, bearbejdning og montage. 

Din uddannelsesmæssig baggrund er ikke afgørende, og du modtager en grundig oplæring.

Du er en holdspiller som selv kan tage initiativ, og du er kvalitetsbevidst og er god til præcisionsarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et team med trivsel og arbejdslyst i fokus

Vi er en spændende virksomhed i udvikling, og i fællesskab bygger vi hver dag mange forskellige nye produkter efter kundernes ønsker.

Ja, faktisk er vi nogle af de største og bedste, så du kommer med på vinderholdet.

Du bliver en del af et team med mange forskellige mennesker og typer, som har til fælles at vi brænder for hinanden og for vores kunderne.

Det er ikke bare noget vi siger, for det er noget vi gør hver dag – og vi beviser det gennem vores trivselsmålinger. Du kan se mere her: https://www.plagborg.dk/karriere/hils-paa-vores-medarbejdere.aspx

Hvis du spørgsmål, så kontakt gerne Adm. direktør Erik T. Lauridsen på telefon 21213242 eller på mail etl@plagborg.dk

Vi ansætter løbende, så send hurtigt din ansøgning.

jobs.title: Open applications for Chief Engineer
jobs.employer: THE QRILL COMPANY AS AVD ÅLESUND
jobs.description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024 we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence. Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

We are now looking for a Chief Engineer who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica

As the Chief Engineer, you will oversee all technical operations within our organization. You will be responsible for leading the engine department, managing projects, and ensuring the efficient operation and maintenance of our equipment and facilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong background as Chief Engineer, exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of success in similar roles. Chief Engineer is overall responsible and in charge of all technical installations onboard the vessel, and all R&M and ordering of spare parts for these components as well as responsible for, and being sure costs are held at or below budget.

Other responsibilities will be:

  • Lead and manage the engine department, providing guidance, mentoring, and support to achieve project goals and objectives.

  • Oversee the design, development, and implementation of engineering projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

  • Manage the maintenance and repair of equipment and infrastructure, optimizing efficiency and minimizing downtime.

  • Collaborate with other departments to support company objectives and initiatives.

  • Develop and implement strategies to improve operational performance and reduce costs.

  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and promote a culture of safety within the engine department.

Your profile

Are you the Chief Engineer we’re looking for?

The right candidate has experience from, preferably, other shipping or fishing companies. You are structured and systematic yet flexible and responsive. You have a positive, can-do attitude and manage to roll up your sleeves with the motivation to respond in a 24/7/365 operation.

Qualifications:

  • Engineer Officer Class 1, CoC M1.

  • Medical Certificate

  • Safety Course for officers

  • At least 5 years of experience in role as Chief Engineer.

  • Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.

  • Proficient in project management software and tools.

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.


Location: Vessel/Antarctica


Application and contact information

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? Please don't hesitate to apply as we will be contacting candidates on an ongoing basis. 

Please send your application letter and CV in either English or Norwegian via the application link.


About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for use in the aquaculture and animal feed markets, as well as deliver raw materials for production of human health supplements. Our value chain stretches from our vessels and sustainable krill harvesting operations in Antarctica, through our logistics hub in Montevideo, and all the way to customers around the world.

The Company operates a fleet of five vessels, including two cargo vessel and three fishing vessels, leading krill fishing within the Antarctic region. The three fishing vessels operate on the fishing grounds year-round, except for one month in October, which is dedicated to maintenance and repairs while the cargo vessel transports products and crew to and from the fishing grounds throughout the year.

Our offices are located in Fornebu and Ålesund, with the logistics base and product warehouse in Montevideo, Uruguay. We are about 500 employees globally, of which about 430 work on board our krill vessels in Antarctica. We are a diverse company with more than 25 nationalities, spread across all time zones and most continents. Together, we form an international, high performing, diverse and fun work environment.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

QRILL™ Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for shrimp, marine fish, and salmonids, increasing productivity in aquaculture - through improved growth, health and quality.

QRILL™ Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with documented health benefits for companion animals. Proven in numerous studies to benefit pet health, the omega-3s help maintain the health of the heart, kidneys, liver, joints, brain, eyes, skin and coat.

Why should you be part of our team?

You can expect hard work and a lot of fun and challenges. In return we promise you will be part of an exciting journey. If you show initiative and desire for more responsibility, we will give it to you and support you along the way. We strongly believe that our team of people want to do their best. All in the spirit of being the leading company in our industry and always striving to raise the bar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are the world’s leading krill company, delivering premium ingredients for human and animal nutrition. Aker QRILL Company is an Antarctic krill-harvesting company dedicated to improving health across species. We develop krill-based ingredients for nutraceutical, aquaculture, and animal feed applications, backed by rigorous science and research into krill’s benefits. Sustainability is at the core of our operations, rooted in world-class standards.

jobs.title: Patient Access and Intake Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description

At ScionHealth, we empower our caregivers to do what they do best. We value every voice by caring deeply for every patient and each other. We show courage by running toward the challenge and we lean into new ideas by embracing curiosity and question asking. Together, we create our culture by living our values in our day-to-day interactions with our patients and teammates.

Job Summary

The Patient Access & Intake Coordinator plays a key role in facilitating a smooth and efficient patient admission process. This position provides vital administrative and operational support to the Business Development team and the Central Access and Authorizations Team (CAAT), ensuring timely initiation and management of referral activity.

Responsible for launching the referral management process, the coordinator oversees admission workflows, gathers and verifies required documentation, coordinates information for necessary approvals, and communicates essential information to relevant departments. Acting as a central liaison between Business Development, facility leadership, and CAAT colleagues, this coordinates admission logistics, confirm readiness to receive the patient, and ensure all clinical and operational details are aligned prior to arrival.

This role actively contributes to quality improvement, problem solving, and productivity initiatives within an interdisciplinary team model, demonstrating accountability and a commitment to operational excellence.

Essential Functions

  • Serves as key team member of the new Central Access and Authorizations Team (CAAT), focused exclusively on intake of referrals and building the initial case for patient admission.
  • Responsible for initiating any patient referral by establishing patient account in appropriate referral management platform
    • Performs a wide variety of typing assignments, including entering demographic information into referral platform and/or Meditech for admission
    • Works with business development team to gather patient information, admission and facility details from multiple referral platforms and sources
    • Validates data and enters complete details into referral platform, establishing the foundation for successful benefit verification, initial prior authorization and ultimate patient admission
    • Manages the entry of care transition program referrals into appropriate platform and working with business development team to manage those referrals
  • Supports the business development team in coordinating the admission of the patient by coordinating bed assignments and any necessary admission paperwork, in collaborating with designated owner at the facility.
    • Confirms that insurance verification / auth is complete
    • Validates patient account and profile and PIC days in appropriate systems of record
    • Communicates specific patient needs for bed, equipment, supplies, pharmacy, and consult services based on information received from business development team
    • Provides hospital team with needed information on pending/new admissions
    • Coordinates bed availability with facility house supervisor
  • Responsible for working with the business development team to maintain accuracy and integrity of the pending referral log in the referral platform, which may include:
    • Review and reconciliation of referral log reports
    • Review and reconciliation of patient accounts in referral management systems
  • Participates in continuing education/ professional development activities
  • Learns and develops full knowledge of the CAAT Admission Processes and actively seeks to continuously improve them.
  • Learns and has a full understanding of scheduling and pre-register routines in Meditech and any other referral platform utilized by the CAAT team (i.e., Referral Manager)
  • And ad hoc duties as assigned that fall within scope of the CAAT team

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities/Expectations

  • Team player, able to communicate and demonstrate a professional image/attitude
  • Excellent oral and written communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong computer skills with both standard and proprietary applications
  • Data entry with attention to detail
  • Conducts job responsibilities in accordance with the standards set out in the Companyâs Code of Business Conduct, its policies and procedures, the Corporate Compliance Agreement, applicable federal and state laws, and applicable professional standards.
  • Communicates and demonstrates a professional image/attitude for patients, families, clients, coworkers and others
  • Adheres to policies and practices of ScionHealth
  • Must read, write, and speak fluent English
  • Must have good and regular attendance
  • Approximate percent of time required to travel: N/A

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • Associates or Bachelors Degree preferred
  • Preference towards a healthcare related area of concentration or be a licensed health care provider or equivalent experience.

Licenses/Certifications

  • None Required

Experience

  • Experience in a healthcare related area is preferred.
  • Work experience in post-acute care a plus.

jobs.title: MYYJÄ S-market Kristiinankaupunki
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KRISTIINANKAUPUNKI

MYYJÄ S-market KristiinankaupunkiIhan tavallisia töitä merellisessä pikkukaupungissa.
Kristiinankaupunki tunnetaan viehättävästä puutalokaupungistaan, merellisestä tunnelmastaan ja kiireettömästä elämäntyylistään. Täällä työ ja vapaa-aika kulkevat luontevasti rinnakkain.

S-market Kristiinankaupungissa etsimme nyt myyjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, jossa työtunteja on vähintään 20 tuntia viikossa. Työsuhde alkaa joustavasti niin pian kuin mahdollista. Myyjän työ koostuu monipuolisista kaupan tehtävistä: asiakaspalvelusta, kassatyöstä, hyllytyksestä, kuorman purusta ja esillepanojen rakentamisesta. Meillä tehdään ihan tavallisia töitä epätavallisen mukavassa työporukassa.

Eepeellä uskomme, että tavallinen työ voi olla parhaimmillaan todella merkityksellistä, kun ympärillä on hyvät työkaverit, toimiva arki ja mahdollisuus kehittyä. Meillä et jää yksin. Kristiinankaupungin S-marketissa työtä tehdään yhdessä, autetaan työkaveria kiireessä ja iloitaan onnistumisista porukalla. Päivät ovat vaihtelevia, ja työssä pääset kohtaamaan ihmisiä sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, että asiakkaidemme arki sujuu mahdollisimman helposti ja mukavasti.

Odotamme sinulta:
Myyjän työssä tarvitaan positiivista asiakaspalveluasennetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja reipasta oma-aloitteisuutta. Etsimme toimeen tarttuvaa tyyppiä, joka ei pelkää ryhtyä töihin ja saa hommat hoidettua. Aikaisempi kokemus kaupanalan tehtävistä on plussaa, mutta positiivinen asenne ja aito halu tehdä asiakaspalvelutyötä ovat tehtävässä menestyäksesi kaikkein tärkeintä.
Me perehdytämme sinut käytännönläheisesti tehtäviisi. Teemme työtä tiiminä, joten arvostamme hyvää työkaveruutta, yhteistyötaitoja sekä valmiutta työskennellä myymälän monipuolisissa työtehtävissä. Edellytämme joustavuutta työskennellä vuorotyössä, kaupan aukioloaikoina. Olethan myös täysi-ikäinen, 18 vuotta täyttänyt.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
Erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.
Koko henkilöstöämme koskevatulospalkkiojärjestelmä
Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan ja hyvinvoinninEpassi-edut
Poikkeuksellisen paljon mahdollisuuksia! Voit vaihtaa ammattia, toimialaa tai ottaa lisätyötä oman osaamisesi ja toiveidesi mukaan

Jos arvostat mutkatonta työarkea, mukavia työkavereita ja mahdollisuutta tehdä tärkeää asiakaspalvelutyötä osana paikallista yhteisöä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö. Lähetä hakemuksesi jo tänään.
Haku on avoinna 10.8.2026 saakka, käsittelemme hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana.

MarketpäällikköHenni tiimeineen odottaa jo hakemustasi.
Lisätietoja: marketpäällikkö henni.lyly@sok.fi/ 010 7646 571

*****
Etelä-Pohjanmaan Osuuskauppa on monipuolinen työpaikka!
Eepee on osuuskauppa,jonka omistavat sen yli 94 000 asiakasomistajaa. Tarjoamme toimialueellamme työpaikan 1300 palvelualan ammattilaiselle lähes 80 toimipaikassamme.
Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. Tavallinen työ on sitä, mitä pitääkin olla – tehokasta, arvokasta ja tärkeää. Ihan tavallisen työn lisäksi, meillä on epätavallisen hyvät edut ja poikkeuksellisen mahtavat työkaverit.

jobs.title: Healthcare Virtual Assistant Athena EMR Experience
jobs.description:
Overview

Snapscale is seeking a highly skilled Healthcare Virtual Assistant to support day-to-day U.S. clinic operations in a remote setup and ensure a seamless patient experience. This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and hands-on experience in U.S. healthcare processes. The ideal candidate must have proven expertise in EMR systems, specifically Athena EMR, and the ability to manage multiple clinical and administrative tasks efficiently while working remotely.

Key Responsibilities

  • Verify patient benefits and insurance coverage accurately and efficiently
  • Reactivate past patients and maintain engagement through consistent follow-ups
  • Handle inbound calls and assist patients with inquiries professionally and empathetically
  • Conduct appointment confirmations, reminders, and outbound follow-ups
  • Schedule and reschedule patient appointments using Athena EMR
  • Maintain and update patient records in Athena EMR (required)
  • Perform medical chart scrubbing to ensure accuracy and completeness of patient data
  • Process and manage prior authorizations following payer and clinic guidelines
  • Handle prescription refills in accordance with clinic protocols
  • Audit laboratory results and follow up on missing or pending reports
  • Support monitoring and coordination of clinic workflows in a remote setting, including virtual systems and tools
  • Minimum 6 months to 1 year of hands-on experience with Athena EMR (required)
  • Experience working with US based clinics and/or health insurance providers
  • Experience in insurance verification, patient coordination, and inbound call handling
  • Experience in medical chart scrubbing and prior authorization processing
  • Experience in refill processing, lab result auditing, and follow-up coordination
  • Medical billing and coding experience is an advantage
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated for remote work
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a dedicated quiet home workspace

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, EMEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Notion EMEA Recruiting team acts as trusted business partners who craft a thorough, inclusive, and curated interviewing experience. We believe hiring exceptional talent, at the right time, is the best path forward to achieve our company’s ambitious goals.

We’re looking for a Go-to-Market Recruiter to support our growth across key Go-to-Market (GTM) teams in EMEA, with an emphasis on Sales. In this role, you'll help shape our recruiting strategy, manage full-cycle hiring efforts, and ensure a delightful yet rigorous hiring process.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to leaders across the GTM org, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing through successful close

 - Design and implement creative sourcing strategies to attract diverse top talent across EMEA markets

 - Ensure scalable and structured hiring plans with consistent evaluation processes while creating thoughtful candidate experiences

 - Partner with cross-functional teams including Total Rewards, People Operations, and People Partners to drive holistic talent strategies

 - Leverage AI tools, to innovate recruiting processes and provide data-driven insights on market conditions

 - Champion and scale best practices while thoughtfully adapting for regional nuances




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, GTM functions

 - Proven track record of identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional talent across various levels

 - Experience coaching and advising hiring managers through our recruiting process while keeping talent density as a priority

 - Ability to build diverse candidate pipelines and guide hiring managers in creating inclusive teams

 - Outstanding communication, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality recruiting experiences

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes

 - Fluency in an additional European language



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Kvalitetsbevidst og ansvarsfuld trykkerimedhjælper til Grafiket A/S i Kolding
jobs.description:
Kvalitetsbevidst og ansvarsfuld trykkerimedhjælper til Grafiket A/S i Kolding

Har du erfaring eller interesse for at arbejde indenfor grafisk produktion og søger du en ny arbejdsdag med moderne produktionsudstyr, kvalitet i fokus og gode kollegiale relationer? Så har du nu muligheden for at blive en del af en solid virksomhed med høj anciennitet, stærkt sammenhold og fokus på et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Som trykkerimedhjælper hos Grafiket i Kolding vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver omfatte:

  • Betjening og overvågning af en flexo skæremaskine i den daglige produktion.

  • Klargøring af materialer samt sikring af korrekt opsætning af maskinen.

  • Løbende kvalitetskontrol af emner og justering af produktionen efter behov.

  • Pakke- og emballeringsopgaver i forbindelse med de færdige produkter.

  • Supportopgaver relateret til flexo-produktionen, herunder hjælp til omstilling, klargøring og optimering af produktionsprocesser.

Vi forestiller os, at du har : 

  • Teknisk erfaring er ønskeligt, men ikke et krav, da maskinen er forholdsvis nem at betjene, og der vil være god oplæring.

  • Jobbet kræver en god fysik i forhold til at håndtere og pakke ruller med etiketter.

  • Det er vigtigt, at man har god kvalitets- og ordenssans.

  • Jobbet kræver godt overblik, og gerne erfaring med computer/IT.

  • Gerne fleksibel ift. varierende opgaver, og god til at holde sig selv i gang.

  • Pligtopfyldende og loyal.

  • Mødestabil og fleksibel ift. overarbejde.

  • Godt humør og god energi 

     

Vi tilbyder

  • Et godt job i en velfungerende organisation, hvor teamwork og medarbejder trivsel prioriteres. 
    Der er en flad struktur, velfungerende personaleforening og flere personalegoder. 

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder da vi gerne tilbyder en erhvervsuddannelsesaftale for rette person,     som er motiveret for at uddanne sig om grafisk tekniker hos os 

  • Virksomheden tilbyder ordnede ansættelsesforhold med pension, sundhedssikring og fritvalgskonto. Derudover er virksomheden omfattet af overenskomst , hvilket sikrer gode og trygge rammer omkring ansættelsen.

Praktiske oplysninger 

Stillingen er fuldtid. 

Ønskede arbejdstider vil være på daghold, men søger du enten aftenarbejde eller har interesse i at køre på flekshold, så er du også meget velkommen til at søge stillingen.

Daghold :  

Mandag til torsdag fra kl.  10.00-17.30 og fredage fra kl.  8.00-15.00. 

Aftenhold : 
Mandag til torsdag fra kl. 12.30-21.00 ( fredage fri)


Flekshold: Daghold/aftenhold
 


Ønsket tiltrædelse 1. september 2026. Der er tale om et try & hire forløb i 4 måneder med henblik på fastansættelse direkte hos Grafiket A/S umiddelbart efter try/hire ansættelsen.


Søg jobbet
Har ovenstående fanget din interesse, søger du stillingen ved at vedhæfte et opdateret cv og en motiveret ansøgning. Du kan også skrive en kort tekst om dig selv i ansøgningsteksten ovenfor. Temp-Team A/S varetager denne rekruttering og al henvendelse skal gå gennem Temp-Team.
Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke cv og ansøgning via e-mail.

Temp-Team
Temp-Team A/S er et landsdækkende rekrutterings- og bemandingsbureau. Vi har mere end 45 års erfaring inden for rekrutteringer til faste jobs og vikarløsninger og dækker et bredt udsnit af brancher. Vi har fokus på høj kvalitet og tæt, personlig kontakt til både kandidater og kunder.

Vi er en del af JuhlerGroup – en international koncern.

jobs.description:
Tervetuloa Onnin lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun!


----------------------------------------

Etsimme joukkoomme lämminhenkisiä ja reippaalla palveluasenteella varustettuja lähihoitajia tai loppuvaiheen opiskelijoita AKAA-LEMPÄÄLÄ SEUDULLE. Toivomme sinulta kokemusta lapsiperheiden ja vammaisten lasten parissa työskentelystä.

Onnin lähihoitajana olet perheiden tuki ja apu arjessa ja työskentelet perheen kotona itsenäisesti palveluperiaatteidemme mukaisesti. Työtehtäviisi sisältyy perheen tarpeiden mukaisesti esim. kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, lastenhoitoa ja muita perhettä tukevia toimia. Työ on pääsääntöisesti päivätyötä arkisin. Voit vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi, ja työskennellä kokoaikaisesti, osa-aikaisesti tai keikkaluontoisesti – elämäntilanteeseesi parhaiten sopivalla tavalla! Arvomme ystävällisyys, joustavuus ja luotettavuus näkyvät päivittäisessä työssämme.

Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä ammatissasi. Onnilaisten rempseä tiimi jakaa arjen kanssasi ja toimii tukenasi. Maksamme sinulle kokemusvuosiesi perusteella 14,82-16.03 e/h.

Kuulumme kotimaiseen Tradeka-konserniin, ja tarjoamme onnilaisille kattavia etuja, kuten:

* Sairauskassan

* Alennuksia Restelin ravintoloissa

Tehtävään valitun henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Computational Nuclear Physics and Reactor Simulations at the Department of Physics. The PhD Research Fellow will be part of the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre (NNRC). 

NNRC is a cross-disciplinary collaboration between Norway’s leading institutions within nuclear physics and nuclear chemistry research: University of Oslo (UiO), Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU), and Institute for Energy Technology (IFE). The Centre addresses major research questions within the nuclear field spanning topics from nuclear properties and medical isotope production to reactor simulations and environmental radiochemistry.

Starting date as soon as possible, preferably before December 1st, 2026.

The fellowship period is three years.

The position may include a fourth year, resulting in a total of 25% of the appointment being dedicated to other career-development activities, normally teaching and/or supervision. This is determined based on the department’s needs and the candidate’s qualifications.”

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 


Project description/work tasks

The Nuclear Physics group at UiO is involved in several research themes within the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre (NNRC), from fundamental research within nuclear properties and nuclear fission, to more applied research within nuclear simulations and radionuclide production and speciation. This PhD Research Fellow will mostly contribute to nuclear simulations (reactor simulations).

The project will include reactor simulations of future reactor systems with a focus on systems relevant for Norway. The objective is to further develop and validate machine-learning surrogate models derived from high-fidelity multiphysics simulations of reactor transients and quantify how surrogate uncertainties propagate through system safety analysis of nuclear installations, using tools such as open simulations platforms.

This research will be part of a larger international collaboration and be a part of the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre. The candidate is expected to contribute to and partake in activities organised by the Centre.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or nuclear technology, with specialization in nuclear physics or reactor physics
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • A solid background in scientific computing, for example Python

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 1 October 2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

The following qualifications are considered strongly desirable and will be used in the ranking of the candidates:

  • Experience with reactor simulations in for example OpenMC or system codes, like RE-LAP
  • Experience with data analysis techniques 
  • Experience using ML
  • Familiarity with data analysis tools such as ROOT
  • Knowledge of reactor physics and nuclear structure from master-level courses
  • Teaching experience

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently
  • Good communication skills
  • Ability to work in an international research environment

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records and documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The research at the Department covers a broad range of subfields within physics and technology: From space research to medical physics. A good proportion of the research is interdisciplinary, and conducted in close cooperation with collaborators in Norway and abroad. Education and teaching are other essential activities. We offer a broad range of courses, and the Department is involved in several study programmes at bachelor’s and master’s level. Some of the best lecturers in Norway are amongst our employees, and we are proud of our prizewinning teaching and learning environment. The Department has 200 employees, of which 50 are permanent scientific positions. On a yearly basis 20 students complete their Ph.D. and 50 finish their M.Sc. degree.

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Fuldtid - Vicevært? Flyttesynstekniker? Handy-person?
jobs.description:
Din titel er ikke afgørende for os. Bare du har hænderne skruet rigtig på og lysten til at blive en del af en virksomhed, hvor vi har tendens til at blive hængende på holdet i lang tid.

Da vi skal starte nye ejendomme op i og omkring Ålborg, så søger vi et team af nye viceværter. Vi forventer at vi skal bruge 1 på fuldtid og 2 på deltid.

Denne her stilling er fuldtid, med mulighed for fleksible arbejdstider, men vi hører gerne til dine forventninger og ser om vi kan få det til at gå op med resten af teamet.

Det er vigtigt at du i din ansøgning oplyser, at den stilling du søger er fuldtid.

Hvem er du og hvorfor passer du ind hos os?
Det går du fordi, du er:

Servicemindet - du nyder en hverdag, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre en god oplevelse for beborerne.

Handy - måske selvlært eller fordi du har en teknisk uddannelse, men du kan løse de fleste udbedringer i lejemålene og på ejendommene selv, som fx udskiftning af blandingsbatterier, kontrol af gulvvarmeanlæg, justering af skabslåger, mm. De ting du ikke har prøvet før, kan du gennemgå med en kollega, så du er godt klædt på til at klare det selv næste gang.

Struktureret og har styr på dine aftaler. Vi sætter stor værdi i at holde, hvad vi lover hinanden og vores kunder.

Motiveret af et fleksibelt arbejdsliv. Du bestemmer selv, om din arbejdsdag starter kl. 8 eller kl. 10 – bare opgaverne bliver løst med høj kvalitet og til tiden.

Hvem er vi og hvorfor er vi sjove at arbejde hos?
Vi er en professionel leverandør af ejendomsservice og vores kunder er udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og lignende. Vi vækster og har netop vundet vores 3. gazelle. Det betyder, at der på sigt kan være mulighed for flere timer eller mere ansvar, hvis det er noget, du ønsker.

Vi har tillid til hinanden og opbakning fra vores chef.

Det betyder, at vi arbejder selvstændigt med vores egne opgaver og at vi altid kan spørge om hjælp, når vi har brug for det.

Vi er uformelle og møder hinanden og vores kunder i øjenhøjde. Samtidig tager vi naturligvis ansvar for vores opgaver og sikrer, at vi løser tingene godt.

Hvad er det så for nogle opgaver, som du kan være med til løse hos os?

Arbejdsopgaverne
•   Pasning og renholdelse af ejendomme
•   Udførelse af ind-/fraflytningssyn
•   Håndtering af lejerhenvendelser og udbedring af ting i lejemålene
•   Evt. pasning af mindre grønne områder, så som græsslåning
•   Andre viceværtsrelevante opgaver

Det med småt

Bil: Da stilling er fuldtid, stiller vi en firmabil til rådighed.

Vi tilbyder dig firmatelefon, tablet og et kollegialt fællesskab med høj trivsel.

Derudover kan du selv frem til en opstart, hvor du bliver klædt på af dine kolleger - som du også lærer at kende til de sociale arrangementer, som vi holder i løbet af året.

Du skal forvente at løse opgaver primært i og omkring Ålborg og Nørresundby. Da vi har kunder i hele Midtjylland, kan der også være behov for at hjælpe kolleger i nogle af de andre midtjyske byer. 

Opstart: Vi søger en profil til opstart i løbet af september, så vi er klar til at vi overtager pasningen af ejendommene til d. 1 oktober. Arbejdstiden i september kan dog være varierende.

Vi holder samtalerne løbende, så tøv ikke med at tage fat i os allerede i dag.

Vil du med?
Lyder det som noget for dig, så send dit CV til andreas@dalboege.com. Du er også meget velkommen til at skrive med eventuelle spørgsmål eller læse mere om os på dalbøgesejendomsservice.dk.

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet det rette match.
