jobs.title: Scaled Outcomes Architect, Dublin, Russian-Speaking
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 3+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - You are a fluent Russian speaker

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €89,000 - €100,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550.  https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de Parc - Régisseur Technique Événementiel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Gestionnaire de parc - Régisseur Technique Événementiel:
Type de contrat
CDI temps plein 35h
Lieu de travail
Conflans-Sainte-Honorine (78)
Salaire
2 000 à 2 300 euros brut par mois selon profil et expérience

Description de l'entreprise
We Rise est une société spécialisée dans la prestation technique événementielle basée en Ile-de-France. Nous accompagnons nos clients sur des événements professionnels, institutionnels, culturels et privés grâce à nos expertises en sonorisation, éclairage, vidéo, captation, murs LED et location de matériel.
Description du poste
Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recrutons un Assistant Chargé de Production Technique & Gestionnaire de Dépôt. Ce poste est central dans l'organisation des prestations de l'entreprise.
Le titulaire du poste assurera la gestion du dépôt et du parc matériel, participera à la préparation technique des événements, coordonnera les ressources nécessaires à la bonne réalisation des prestations et assurera le suivi des sous-locations et fournisseurs.
Ce recrutement peut faire l'objet d'une POEI (Préparation Opérationnelle à l'Emploi Individuelle) en partenariat avec France Travail pour les candidats éligibles.

Missions principales
Gestion du dépôt et du parc matériel : suivi des entrées et sorties, organisation du dépôt, préparation des commandes, contrôle des retours, inventaires, suivi SAV et réparations, maintenances préventives, gestion des consommables.
Préparation technique des prestations : analyse des besoins techniques, construction des listes de matériel dans Rentman, vérification des disponibilités, identification des besoins en sous-location, préparation des dossiers techniques et briefs équipes, rédaction des feuilles de route.
Coordination opérationnelle : planification des équipes techniques, organisation des chargements et déchargements, suivi opérationnel des projets, circulation des informations entre les intervenants.
Gestion des sous-locations et fournisseurs : identification des besoins, consultation des fournisseurs, suivi des devis, organisation des retraits et retours de matériel sous-loué.

Profil recherché
Expérience indispensable dans la prestation technique événementielle, acquise chez un prestataire technique audiovisuel ou une structure événementielle. Une expérience en préparation de matériel, exploitation, régie, sonorisation, éclairage ou vidéo constitue un atout.
Formation souhaitée : BTS Métiers de l'Audiovisuel, BTS Techniques du Spectacle, Licence Professionnelle ou formation équivalente dans les métiers de l'événementiel.

Compétences requises
Bonne connaissance de l'environnement de la prestation technique événementielle. Bonne culture générale des métiers du son, de l'éclairage et de la vidéo. Excellente aisance informatique et appétence pour les logiciels métiers. La connaissance de Rentman constitue un plus. Organisation, rigueur, sens des responsabilités, esprit d'équipe et capacité d'apprentissage.
Evolution du poste
Selon les compétences et l'autonomie acquises, des évolutions vers les fonctions de Chargé de Production Technique, Coordinateur Technique ou Responsable Exploitation Technique sont envisagées.

Avantages
Heures supplémentaires rémunérées ou récupérées. Formation et accompagnement à la prise de poste.

Candidature
Merci de lire cette annonce jusqu'au bout avant de postuler.
Pour que votre candidature soit étudiée, vous devez impérativement remplir le formulaire de candidature à l'adresse suivante :
https://forms.gle/63tGZx4rHBMD3SQm8
Les candidatures transmises sans formulaire complété ne seront pas traitées.

jobs.title: Project Management Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the role
 The Project Management Coordinator role is essential for maintaining the structure and rhythm of our high level advisory work. In this position, you will support our principals as we assist a major regional logistics and transportation group through a complex transition of their operating model. You will provide the organizational support needed to ensure that our strategic recommendations are tracked, documented, and moved toward a final decision.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for significant family groups and government entities. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis over traditional office overhead.

What you will do
  • Coordinate project timelines and schedules to ensure that all mandate milestones are met on time.
  • Support our principals in gathering research and data related to the logistics sector to help form a clear view on client challenges.
  • Draft concise internal updates and reports regarding the progress of specific portfolio projects.
  • Organize and maintain project documentation to ensure all data is accurate and accessible to the team.
  • Monitor project risks or delays and communicate them clearly to the responsible partners.
  • Assist in the preparation of governance documents and strategy materials for board level presentations.
  • Track communication between our firm and client representatives to maintain a clear record of decisions made.
  • Support the refinement of client operating models by documenting current processes and proposed changes.


What we are looking for
  • A logical mindset and the ability to organize complex information into clear, actionable steps.
  • Strong writing skills with a focus on precision and the ability to communicate ideas without using corporate jargon.
  • A high level of attention to detail when reviewing documents and project schedules.
  • Curiosity about how large holding companies and regional logistics firms function at a governance level.
  • The ability to work independently and manage your own tasks effectively in a remote setting.
  • Basic familiarity with digital tools for project tracking or a strong willingness to learn our specific methods.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which allows us to focus on the clarity of our thinking rather than the logistics of an office. This model requires a high degree of professional maturity and trust. We value intellectual honesty and direct communication, where the quality of an idea is more important than the title of the person who suggests it. As an entry level member of the team, you will receive direct mentoring from our principals, gaining exposure to how significant corporate decisions are made and executed. We prioritize high impact work on a small number of mandates, ensuring that our team can remain focused on results rather than simple activity.

What the role offers
  • Direct involvement in high level strategy mandates for a major regional logistics and infrastructure client.
  • Competitive pay that is attractive for the market and reflective of the importance of this role.
  • A permanent, fully remote position that offers professional autonomy and flexibility.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who are leaders in the fields of governance and corporate strategy.
  • A professional environment that values sober analysis and clear communication over corporate theater.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is looking for a Head of Demand Engine to build the engine that turns our best product stories, customer proof, and market opportunities into scaled pipeline. You’ll lead demand programs across campaigns, digital, paid strategy, webinars, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing on audience and offer strategy, with Performance Marketing on paid execution, and with Field Marketing & Events on the moments that benefit from in-person activation.




This is a senior leadership role with both AMER and global scope. You’ll help set the global standard for how Notion plans, runs, tests, and measures demand programs, while learning from strong regional teams and making the best ideas repeatable across markets. You’ll lead a growing team spanning demand programs and digital demand, with room to expand into areas like partner marketing over time.




This is a build job as much as a run job. We’re looking for someone with real taste who can spot a strong idea, turn it into a sharp program, and build a repeatable engine around what works. You should care about quality and craft, but also love testing, data, systems, and execution. The opportunity is to modernize demand generation at one of the companies defining how teams work with AI.




This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Own the demand programs strategy, calendar, and operating rhythm across priority audiences, segments, and offers.

 - Turn strong product stories, content, customer proof, and market opportunities into integrated programs that can scale across channels and regions.

 - Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set a high bar for creative and execution, learn quickly, and put more weight behind what works.

 - Serve as the global point person for paid digital demand strategy. Define the audiences, offers, creative, programs, and goals, then partner closely with Performance Marketing on execution and optimization.

 - Lead digital demand across webinars, email, web, review sites, nurture, and new formats, creating new programs where the strategy calls for them.

 - Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to build a trusted global approach to marketing ROI, attribution, forecasting, MQA/MQL methodology, and campaign reporting.

 - Work closely with Enterprise Product Marketing on audience, offer, and campaign strategy, and with Field Marketing & Events on coordinated execution.

 - Help build our muscle in account-based marketing and partner marketing as those motions develop.

 - Be a trusted partner to Sales and executive leadership. Bring a clear point of view, make the numbers legible, and advocate for what will have the most impact.

 - Hire, coach, and lead a strong team across demand programs and digital demand.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A track record of building and scaling B2B demand programs that create qualified pipeline.

 - Strong judgment and taste. You can point to specific programs that worked because the audience, offer, creative, and execution were sharp.

 - Deep digital demand experience across paid strategy, email, web, webinars, nurture, and integrated campaigns.

 - A testing mindset and the operating discipline to turn learnings into repeatable programs, systems, and investment decisions.

 - Comfort with data. You can work closely with Marketing Ops and RevOps on attribution, reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and translate the numbers into clear action.

 - Executive presence. You earn trust with Sales and company leaders, hold a strong point of view, and are comfortable making hard calls.

 - Experience leading and developing strong teams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Experience operating across regions, or genuine curiosity and appetite to build globally.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. This model is still being written, and you’ll help write it.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building account-based marketing programs.

 - Experience with partner or ecosystem marketing.

 - Experience working across both product-led and sales-assisted growth motions.




WHY THIS ROLE

This is one of the most visible, highest-impact seats in Notion’s marketing org. You’ll have the mandate to build the demand engine, shape how we measure marketing ROI globally, and work directly with Sales, RevOps, company leaders, and regional marketing teams.



The playbook for B2B demand generation is changing. Buyers expect better content and experiences, AI is reshaping how programs get built, and old attribution models are under pressure. If you want to apply what already works, challenge what doesn’t, and help define a more modern model, this is the job.

jobs.description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

About the Role

MrBeast is looking for a data-driven, creative, and fast-paced Video Editor to join our Content & Post-Production team working on the MrBeast Reacts channel. This role is for a master-level editor who lives and breathes YouTube culture, capable of transforming raw multi-cam reaction feeds into hyper-engaging content that keeps millions of viewers locked in. You will thrive in a high-feedback environment, balancing aggressive production schedules with a relentless obsession for frame-by-frame pacing and audience retention.

What You'll Do
  • Cut and assemble raw multi-cam reaction footage, seamlessly balancing primary talent commentary, PIP source media, and visual punch-ins.
  • Engineer high-retention video intros and hooks that immediately fulfill title and thumbnail promises within the first 30 seconds.
  • Execute hyper-fast pacing, comedic timing, and visual pop-ups, including kinetic typography, memes, and custom tracking graphics.
  • Perform high-quality sound design, including impactful SFX, dynamic music ducking, and precise audio balancing for voice clarity.
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Editors and creative teams to incorporate rapid turnaround notes and feedback loops.
  • Analyze YouTube retention curves alongside lead editors to pinpoint drop-off moments and refine pacing rules for subsequent edits.
  • Maintain clean, highly organized timeline projects in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, adhering to internal post-production standards.
  • Coordinate with the thumbnail team to ensure visual assets and key video climaxes align perfectly with channel creative strategy.
  • Stay ahead of internet culture and viral editing meta to continuously inject fresh humor and visual variety into channel content.
What We're Looking For
  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience focused on high-pacing YouTube, commentary, or viral digital content.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, specifically with keyframing, motion tracking, masking, and dynamic linking.
  • Deep structural understanding of YouTube algorithm dynamics, Average View Duration (AVD), CTR, and retention curve analysis.
  • Mastery of dynamic sound design, audio leveling, and music curation to enhance comedic and emotional shifts.
  • A data-driven mindset that prioritizes viewer retention evidence over personal creative assumptions.
  • High feedback sensitivity, with the ability to handle rapid creative criticism constructively and pivot quickly.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, maintaining frame-by-frame precision in pacing and visual overlays.
  • Proven ability to manage high-volume workflows, including file compression, color correction, and final exports optimized for YouTube.
  • Extreme ownership over end-to-end video performance, production deadlines, and technical accuracy.
BenefitsThe Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

  • Company-provided technology packageÂ

Director of Sales- East

Remote- New York Metro

FT/Exempt

Compensation:

$70,000 â $80,000 annual base salary, plus a competitive bonus opportunity. Final compensation will be commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications.


ABOUT THE COMPANY

ROAR is redefining hydration for a new generation. In a category that has become overly serious and hardcore performance obsessed, ROAR stands for something different: hydration that is expressive, effortless, and rooted in real life. Built for people who move, connect, and live life out loud, ROAR delivers complete hydration with vitamins, antioxidants, and electrolytes - all with just 20 calories and 3g of sugar or less per bottle.


More than a beverage, ROAR is a cultural signal - bright, approachable, and fun. It rejects the intensity and rules of traditional hydration in favor of something more human: joy, spontaneity, and the kind of movement that doesnât need a scoreboard. This positioning has resonated with consumers and retailers alike driving strong momentum across both natural and conventional retail, where ROAR continues to expand rapidly and now ranks as the #2 brand in the natural channel within the enhanced water category.

 

ROLE OVERVIEW

ROAR Organic is seeking a hands-on Sales Leader to drive profitable growth in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role is responsible for leading all sales activities across grocery customers in the New York Metro area, including new business development, key account management, and executing data-driven strategies to expand market share and increase brand awareness.


The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of scaling high-growth brands profitably, with experience managing both established and emerging grocery retailers, as well as partners. They are highly relationship-driven, resourceful, and action-oriented, with strong communication and organizational skills. This leader excels at building and implementing the strategies, tools, and processes needed to support sustained growth.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver against Annual Operating Plan targets, including gross/net sales and trade spend objectives.
  • Grow distribution and topline revenue with a focus on regional and independent retailers.
  • Execute customer sales strategies, promotional calendars, and account plans.
  • Leverage distributer incentive programs and independent retailer promotional opportunities to drive sales.
  • Conduct weekly route rides with distributor sales representatives to support execution and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and own a field execution strategy based on weekly trend reports, promotional planners, and merchandising opportunities.
  • Manage and execute trade spend programs to drive profitable growth and promotional effectiveness.
  • Leverage syndicated data (IRI, SPINS) to communicate compelling, retailer-specific presentations.
  • Track, measure, and analyze performance metrics, including ROI.
  • Represent the brand at regional and national trade shows, customer meetings, and industry events.

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 2 years of CPG sales experience.
  • Strong understanding of the beverage and grocery landscape, including retailers and distributors.
  • Experience executing sales planning initiatives.
  • Creative, solutions-oriented problem solver with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Thrives in a hands-on, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with syndicated data tools (SPINS, IRI) preferred.
  • Ability to travel extensively as needed.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 30 pounds.
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

- haluat kohdata ihmiset arvostavasti ja inhimillisesti

- yöpainotteinen työ sopii sinulle

Työn, jossa sinuun luotetaan ja osaamistasi arvostetaan. Mahdollisuuden tehdä itsenäistä työtä ilman, että jäät yksin. Mukavan, osaavan ja helposti lähestyttävän työyhteisön. Huolellisen perehdytyksen ja tuen onnistumiseesi. Merkityksellisen työn, jossa jokainen työvuoro on tärkeä.

**Yölläkin tehdään arvokasta työtä – tule tekemään sitä kanssamme.**

jobs.description:
Vi søger nu en bedemand, som har lyst til at blive en del af Min afsked. En kollega, som har lyst til at gøre en forskel for andre mennesker. Hvis du ser dig selv som kreativ, empatisk og respektfuld, har vi måske jobbet til dig.

Vi tilbyder et yderst interessant job med stor variation af opgaver, stor selvstændighed og frihed under ansvar.

Du får selvfølgelig grundig introduktion til vores virksomhed og jobbet som bedemand.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. bestå af:

- Samtaler med familier

- Administrative opgaver i forbindelse med begravelser og bisættelser

- Kørsel i rustvogn

- Afholdelse af højtideligheder

- Iklædning og istandgørelse af de afdøde

Du er god til at arbejde selvstændigt, fremstår respektfuld og empatisk. Du er kreativ og løsningsorienteret - både ift. dine kollegaer og ift. de pårørende. Du trives i et job, hvor det til tider er hektisk, med mange bolde i luften og hvor to dage ikke er ens.

Følgende kvalifikationer er en fordel men ikke et krav:

- Du er - eller har været - ansat som bedemand

- Du er erfaren bilist

- Du besidder basale IT-færdigheder

- Du er dygtig til at formulere dig på skrift

Stillingen er på gennemsnitligt 37 timer, og du kommer til at indgå i en vagtplan, hvor der også er aften- og weekendarbejde.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Send dit CV og ansøgning til Else på else@minafsked.dk

Spørgsmål vedr. jobbet rettes ligeledes til denne mail.

Tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt og vi ansætter, når vi finder den rette til jobbet. Vi behandler derfor alle ansøgninger løbende.

jobs.title: Senior Graphic Designer
jobs.description:
Are you a talented Senior Designer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers & designers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Sounds good, yeah?
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.

 

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Graphic Design

Other requirements:

  • Strong design craft — as a Senior Designer, you're expected to build polished, production-ready work from scratch, with a solid grasp of design systems, component architecture, and how your decisions translate into real product or brand outcomes.
  • Clear and confident communication in English — advanced ability to discuss creative briefs, defend design decisions, and flag blockers early. Strong self-presentation is essential, particularly on client calls.
  • High ownership, zero hand-holding — you thrive working full-time remotely, manage your own time, and consistently hit deadlines without being chased.
  • Reliability — we need to trust you completely. If you commit to something, you deliver it. If something changes, you communicate early.
  • Fast ramp-up — you can absorb project context quickly, align with existing style guides or brand directions, and start producing valuable work within the first days, not weeks.

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We have a variety of projects, so if you have 4+ years of commercial software development experience and are proficient in AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Dart, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Data Annotation, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering, we would be happy to connect with you and match you with a project that fits your experience.

jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Director
jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About The Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

jobs.title: LLM Engineer Freelancer
jobs.description:
We're building a network of LLM Engineers who can design, build, and integrate practical AI features into existing products. We're looking for people to collaborate with on a freelance basis - part-time or full-time, depending on project needs.

This role is focused on delivery, not ML research. What matters most is your engineering foundation and your ability to integrate AI into real production systems using Python, Node.js, or Ruby codebases.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Strong software engineering background - Python, Node.js, or Ruby
  • Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar)
  • Ability to design pragmatic AI solutions within existing architectures
  • Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector search
  • Understanding of cost, latency, and reliability constraints of AI systems
  • Ability to work independently with clients and set realistic expectations
  • Background in big data or data pipelines is a big plus
  • English B2/C1
  • Availability part-time or full-time (B2B contract)

What You'll Do

  • Add AI functionality into existing Python, Node.js, and Ruby codebases
  • Build LLM-powered features: chat, summaries, classification, smart search, document Q&A
  • Design lightweight RAG pipelines using embeddings and vector search
  • Work with vector DBs (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant)
  • Implement safe, reliable LLM endpoints (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure)
  • Work directly with clients to shape AI features and reduce manual effort
  • Advise clients when NOT to use AI and navigate trade-offs around latency, accuracy, and cost

jobs.title: Unicon søger produktionsassistent til Skejby
jobs.description:
- Der kan håndtere både beton og branchens bedste kollegaer 

Vil du være med til at lægge fundamentet for hele Danmark?  

Er du hærdet til at blande frisk beton? Og vil du være en del af et helstøbt og solidt arbejdsmiljø hos Danmarks førende betonproducent? Hvis du samtidig kan lide at håndtere tekniske udfordringer og arbejde med analyser og prøver i vores laboratorium, så er du måske vores nye produktionsassistent. 

Fremtidens støbninger kræver, at DU er af den rette støbning 

Som produktionsassistent hos Unicon er du noget helt specielt. Gjort af et særligt stof; og med passion for det job, du udfører sammen med dine mange dygtige kollegaer. Og det er nødvendigt, for DU er personen i centrum af maskinrummet. Det er dig, det står og falder med, at teknikernes recepter bliver til præcis den beton, kunderne efterspørger; dig, der har ansvaret for, at alting kører på skinner. Det kræver overblik, foruden tekniske kompetencer, snilde, viden om cement, sand, sten, vand og additiver, og det kræver en sikker hånd på vores avancerede udstyr.  

Du bliver tilknyttet fabrikken i Skejby, hvor du vil indgå i vores team af produktionsassistenter, der også vil hjælpe med din oplæring. Du vil også skulle afløse på andre fabrikker i området. 

Der er flere gode grunde til at blive produktionsassistent hos Unicon: 

  • Vi har branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold 

  • En aktiv og spændende arbejdsdag med mange varierende arbejdsopgaver 

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning, hvor vi også vasker tøjet for dig 

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder både fagligt og personligt og spændende karrieremuligheder 

  • Fleksibilitet for dig i forhold til vagter og arbejdssted 

  • En helt unik holdånd 

  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring i jobbet 

At være en del af holdet hos Unicon er noget ganske særligt, og kræver, at du også er det  

Har du hvad der skal til for at blive produktionsassistent hos Unicon, så er det nu, du har chancen.  

For at være af den rette støbning, kræver det at, 

  • Du har erfaring med planlægning af produktionsprocesser og leverancer – og er vant til at arbejde med forskellige IT-systemer i forbindelse med planlægning 

  • Du har gode samarbejdsevner og er serviceminded – både overfor kunder og kollegaer 

  • Du har en teknisk og mekanisk forståelse 

  • Du har hænderne rigtigt skruet på og er ikke bange for at tage fat  

Vi har ingen krav til en specifik uddannelse, men er du tidligere uddannet smed, mekaniker eller elektriker, vil det være en fordel, ligesom erfaring fra bygge-/entreprenørbranchen også vil være et plus. 

Sådan bliver du en del af holdet 

Hvis du vil med på holdet, så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Såfremt du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte fabriksleder Casper Sakskjær Nielsen på telefon +45 2688 4995. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har den rette kandidat.  

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: Ready to take ownership of the German market? Stock Group A/S is looking for a Key Account Manager.
jobs.description:
About this role

Stock Group is a Danish FMCG distributor with a growing portfolio of celebrity chef brands across Northern Europe. We are expanding into Germany and are looking for a Key Account Manager to build and own our commercial presence in the market.

Our flagship brand in Germany is a product line developed, owned and distributed by Stock Group — built around one of Germany's most recognised celebrity chef profiles. The brand has strong TV heritage, wide consumer recognition, and a product range that speaks directly to the everyday home cook. Full brand details are shared with candidates during the interview process.

You will be based at our headquarters in Vejle, Denmark, with regular travel to Germany. We are open to candidates based in Germany if the profile is right, but our strong preference is for someone based in Vejle with experience managing international markets from Denmark.

Reporting directly to the Head of Sales, you will work closely with a tight-knit KAM team that has built this model from the ground up.

What you will be doing

  • Building and managing key account relationships with retail chains, grocery buyers, and trade partners in Germany

  • Driving sell-in of our brand portfolio — presenting ranges, negotiating listings, and following up on performance

  • Planning and executing in-store activations, promotions, and trade marketing initiatives

  • Tracking market dynamics, competitor activity, and customer needs — feeding insights back to the team in Vejle

  • Travelling regularly to Germany to meet buyers, visit stores, and attend relevant trade events

  • Working closely with colleagues across sales, marketing, and supply chain in Denmark

The brands you will work with

In Germany, you will be selling a Stock Group brand built around a leading celebrity chef — one of the strongest commercial chef profiles in the German-speaking market. The product range covers cookware, knives, and kitchen essentials with proven consumer appeal. Further details are shared confidentially during the hiring process.

Our chef brands are built on strong TV personalities, high consumer recognition, and product ranges covering hybrid cookware, knives, airfryers, kitchen appliances and accessories. Your job is to get them listed, activated, and selling.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a commercially driven KAM with genuine FMCG experience — someone who knows how to open doors, build relationships with buyers, and drive sell-through on the shelf.

  • FMCG/retail experience. You have worked in sales, KAM, or trade marketing — ideally with exposure to grocery, electronics retail, or housewares.

  • Strong communicator. You are confident presenting to buyers, negotiating terms, and building rapport at all levels of a retail organisation.

  • Self-starter. You take ownership of your market without needing daily supervision — but you know when to bring the team in.

  • Language skills. English. Germany language skills are a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable with travel. The role involves regular visits to Germany to meet buyers, visit stores, and attend relevant trade events.

A brand with proven demand — before you walk in the door

Behind every brand in our portfolio sits Stock Group's full commercial engine — product development, logistics, content production, and dedicated direct-to-consumer ecom shops running in each chef's name across our active markets.

While our German ecom presence is in preparation, we enter the market fully ready: a complete product range, professional content and marketing assets, and documented consumer and sales data from our established markets that removes the guesswork from day one.

You will not be pioneering in the dark. You will be bringing a model that already works — into one of Europe's largest retail markets.

What we offer

  • A strong and growing portfolio of celebrity chef brands with genuine consumer pull

  • A Denmark-based role — work from our Vejle HQ with a team that has three years of market experience to draw on

  • Full support from marketing, supply chain, and finance — you sell, we back you up

  • Real ownership of your market from day one

  • Competitive salary, travel budget, and benefits package

 

How to apply

Send your CV and a brief cover note. Tell us why you are the right person to build our presence in Germany. For questions, contact Head of Sales Steffan Voss at: steffan@stockgroup.dk or +45 81 37 67 47

We review applications on a rolling basis — don't wait.

jobs.title: Nat med mening- vi søger dig, der vil gøre en forskel, når andre sover!
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at gøre en forskel om natten? Trives du med ansvar, selvstændighed og høj faglighed? Så er du måske vores nye kollega på det udekørende nathold i Svendborg Kommune.

 

Har du lyst til at bruge dine kompetencer og blive fagligt udfordret?

 

Vi søger en fast vikar til en tidsbegrænset ansættelse fra 1. oktober 2026 til og med 31. januar 2027.

 

Vi hører meget gerne fra dig, uanset om du er ufaglært med erfaring fra plejen, social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent.

 

Om jobbet:

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst kollega til vores udekørende nathold. Du bliver en del af en velfungerende sektion med 12 dygtige og dedikerede medarbejdere, som hver nat arbejder for at skabe tryghed, kvalitet og nærvær for borgerne i Svendborg Kommune.

 

Du får et tæt samarbejde med sygeplejerskerne i den udekørende sygepleje og akutfunktionen, som også er på arbejde om natten. Samtidig har du en synlig leder og en planlægger tæt på, som du altid kan sparre med.

 

Hos os er arbejdsmiljøet lige så vigtigt som fagligheden. Vi tror på, at høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen skabes gennem psykologisk tryghed, gensidig respekt og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab. Derfor søger vi en kollega, der både vil bidrage fagligt og være med til at passe på den kultur, vi er stolte af.

 

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Er ufaglært med erfaring fra plejen, social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent.
  • Har kørekort.
  • Er engageret, udviklingsorienteret og tager initiativ.
  • Tager ansvar og kan argumentere fagligt for sine beslutninger.
  • Arbejder med udgangspunkt i borgerens ressourcer og med fokus på rehabilitering.
  • Bevarer roen og overblikket i pressede situationer – og tør række ud efter hjælp.
  • Er mødestabil og en positiv rollemodel.
  • Er nysgerrig og anerkendende i samarbejdet med borgere, pårørende, kolleger, ledelse og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Bidrager til en kultur præget af psykologisk tryghed, respekt og samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og lærer af hinanden.
  • Har lyst til at være en del af en dynamisk kollegagruppe, hvor vi spiller hinanden gode og værner om det stærke fællesskab.

 

Om dig:

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har høj faglighed og trives med selvstændigt ansvar.
  • Kan bevare roen og træffe gode beslutninger – også når tempoet er højt.
  • Er kreativ og løsningsorienteret i din tilgang til opgaverne.
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og respektfuldt.
  • Har flair for dokumentation og IT.
  • Bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø og et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde.

 

Om os:

Hos os bliver du en del af et nathold, hvor faglighed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd. Vi prioriterer psykologisk tryghed, en synlig ledelse, tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og spiller hinanden gode. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes sammen, og at et godt arbejdsmiljø er fundamentet for god pleje.

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En grundig introduktion med mentorordning og oplæring ved erfarne kolleger.
  • En sektion med god struktur, planlægning og et sundt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Et dynamisk arbejdssted med spændende og afvekslende opgaver.
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • En planlagt vagtdækning, hvor den rette faglighed altid er til stede, når der er brug for den. 

 

Ældreområdet
Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkelt dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd.

 

Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældre liv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Til gengæld gør vi os umage med altid at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed, respekt og høj faglighed.

 

Vi skaber de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt, og vi har samtidig høje forventninger til din faglighed. Hos os får du mulighed for at bruge dine kompetencer og udvikle dem yderligere.

 

Om Svendborg Kommune
Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling.

 

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden.

 

Vores værdier findes ikke kun på papiret, vi bruger dem faktisk som kompas hver dag. Vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde, i dialog og med tillid, og sammen skaber vi en tryg ramme, hvor vi alle kan løse vores opgaver selvstændigt, fleksibelt og ansvarligt.


Løn og ansættelse:
Stillingen er en tidsbegrænset ansættelse som fast vikar fra 1. oktober 2026 til og med 31. januar 2027 .

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer om ugen, men vi er fleksible og vil så vidt muligt imødekomme dine ønsker til timetal.

Arbejdsstedet er; Fåborgvej 64, 5700 Svendborg

 

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem disse intervaller pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse.

 

Social- og sundhedsassistenter

35.268

45.496

Social- og sundhedshjælpere

33.160

41.943

Social- og sundhedspersonale, ikke-udd.

25.438

30.608

 

Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

 

Der skal afleveres en privat straffeattest ved ansættelse i stillingen.

 

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

 

Ansøgningsfrist: 

 

Ansøgningsfristen er den 9. august 2026

 

Der planlægges ansættelsessamtaler mandag den 17. august. 

 

For yderligere information er du velkommen til at kontakte Sektionsleder Anne Hasseltoft på telefon 2479 6103.

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

   

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

Tukenasi ovat mukavat työkaverit, yhteen hiilen puhaltava tiimi sekä hyvä ja innostava työilmapiiri ja esihenkilöiden tuki.

Tuemme uusien työntekijöidemme töiden aloittamista perehdyttämisohjelmalla. Nimeämme uusille tulijoille aina ohjaajan. Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue tarjoaa erilaisia työpaikkaetuja sekä hyvät koulutusmahdollisuudet.

Jos tunnistit itsesi, niin jätä hakemus mahdollisimman pian.

Kutsumme hakijoita haastatteluun jo hakuaikana, joten pidäthän puhelimen lähelläsi.

jobs.title: AI Product Engineer (PropTech)
jobs.description:
**Takaovi Oy · Takaovi Palvelut Oy – etätyö mahdollista**

Oletko uutta kehittäjäsukupolvea, jolle AI ei ole lisäosa vaan työtapa? Haluatko rakentaa asuntosijoittamisen ensimmäistä AI-natiivia tuotetta, jolla luodaan sijoittajille ennen näkemätöntä lisäarvoa — ja omistaa työsi ideasta tuotantoon asti?

**Takaovi Oy** / **Takaovi Palvelut Oy** on noin 30 hengen konserni, joka palvelee asunto- ja kiinteistösijoittajia koko Suomessa. Löydämme parhaat sijoituskohteet ja hoidamme kohteet vuokravälityksestä vuokrasuhteen hallinnointiin. Hallinnoinnissamme on noin 3 000 asuntoa. Olemme panostaneet teknologiakehitykseen lähes 10 vuoden ajan, ja rakennamme alustaa, joka automatisoi kiinteistösijoittamisen arkea — sitä, mitä maailmalla kutsutaan PropTechiksi. Emme ole kiinteistöfirma, jolla on IT-osasto: teknologia on kilpailuetumme ydin.

**Mitä pääset tekemään**

- **Rakennat ominaisuuksia tuotantoon asti**— full-stack, AI-avusteisesti (Claude, Copilot tai vastaavat ovat meillä arkipäivää, ja odotamme että osaat johtaa AI:ta, et vain käyttää sitä)

- **Pyörität kehitysprojektia itsenäisesti**: valmistelet, esität, vakuutat ja toteutat — et odota valmiiksi pureskeltuja tikettejä

- **Ohjaat offshore-kehittäjämme työtä**Intiassa: speksaat, priorisoit ja reviewaat englanniksi

- **Kasvat kohti teknisen kehityksen vetovastuuta**— roolisi laajenee jokaisella onnistumisella, ja saat suoran mentoroinnin yrityksen teknologiajohdolta

- Pääset lähelle bisnestä: opit ymmärtämään asuntosijoittajan arkea ja näet, miten koodisi muuttuu asiakkaan hyödyksi


**Mitä odotamme**

- Riittävää ymmärrystä teknologioista, jotta pidät AI:n hanskassa. Meillä koodia ei kirjoiteta käsin rutiinina — AI kirjoittaa, sinä johdat, luet ja varmistat.

- Näyttöjä siitä, että saat ohjelmistoja valmiiksi ja tuotantoon — muodollista tutkintoa kiinnostavampaa on, mitä olet rakentanut.

- Modernin web-kehityksen ymmärrystä / osaamista.

- Aitoa AI-natiivia työtapaa: osaat pilkkoa ongelman, ohjata AI-työkaluja ja tunnistaa, milloin tuotos on väärin.

- Kykyä ja halua ottaa vastuuta kokonaisuudesta: projektinhallinta ei ole sinulle kirosana vaan keino saada asioita valmiiksi.

- Sujuvaa suomea ja työkielen tasoista englantia (säännöllinen yhteistyö offshore-kehittäjän kanssa).

- Plussaa, muttei edellytys: kiinnostus asunto- tai kiinteistösijoittamiseen — jos olet sitä joskus harkinnut tai jo harrastat, tämä rooli vie sinut aitiopaikalle!


**Mitä tarjoamme**

- Poikkeuksellisen ison vapauden ja vastuun heti alusta — ja selkeän kasvupolun kohti tech lead -roolia

- Suoran mentorointisuhteen: et jää yksin, mutta sinua ei myöskään mikromanageerata

- Vakaan yrityksen, joka on investoinut teknologiaan lähes vuosikymmenen — startup-vapaus ilman startup-riskiä

- Täyden etätyömahdollisuuden mistä päin Suomea tahansa

- Modernit työkalut ja aidosti AI-first-kulttuurin: täällä ei tarvitse pyytää lupaa käyttää parhaita työkaluja

- Palkka 3 600 – 4 600 €/kk kokemuksesi mukaan — kokemuksen ja roolin kasvaessa myös ansiotaso nousee

jobs.title: Myyjä, Prisma Kirkkonummi / Försäljare, Prisma Kyrkslätt
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KIRKKONUMMI

MYYJÄ, PRISMA KIRKKONUMMI, 25 H/VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Tässä tehtävässä päiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista myyjän työtehtävistä myymälän eri osa-alueilla. Työ painottuu tuorepuolen hyllytykseen, joten toivomme että pidät aktiivisesta ja fyysisestä työstä. Tehtävään kuuluu myös kassatyöskentelyä, minkä vuoksi hyvä asiakaspalveluasenne ja sujuva työskentely erilaisissa tilanteissa ovat tärkeitä. Monipuolisten työtehtävien ansiosta päivät ovat vaihtelevia, eikä askelia päivän aikana ainakaan puutu.

Me Prisma Kirkkonummella teemme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta juuri nyt elämme myös erityisen innostavaa vaihetta: Prismaa laajennetaan parhaillaan, ja pääset mukaan kokemaan myymälämme kehityksen aivan eturivistä.

Tässä tehtävässä:
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Tarvitaan reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta.
- Otetaan vastuuta omasta työstä ja yhteisten asioiden edistämisestä osana tiimiä
- Tehdään yhteistyötä muun työryhmän kanssa hyvässä hengessä ja pidetään omalta osalta huolta osaston toimivuudesta
- Liikutaan paljon, nostellaan tavaraa ja tehdään töitä ripeässä tahdissa, joten hyvä peruskunto on työssä hyödyksi
- Tehdään töitä vaihtelevissa vuoroissa kaupan aukioloaikoina klo 5-24 välillä, myös juhlapyhinä
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi


Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.

Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta (10,89 €/h – 14,57 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtunti tulospalkkioon yrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Jos ihan tavallinen työelämä houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan!

Jätä hakemuksesi ihan viimeistään sunnuntaina 9.8.2026 – mutta älä turhaan aikaile, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa Myyntipäällikkö Agneta Lundell (agneta.lundell@sok.fi ja p.0107626661) .Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

**

FÖRSÄLJARE, PRISMA KYRKSLÄTT, 25 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

I den här rollen består dina dagar av mångsidiga säljaruppgifter inom butikens olika områden. Arbetet fokuserar på varuplock på färskvarusidan, så vi hoppas att du trivs med ett aktivt och fysiskt arbete. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår också kassaarbete, därför är en god serviceattityd och förmåga att arbeta smidigt i olika situationer viktiga. Tack vare de mångsidiga arbetsuppgifterna är dagarna varierande, och steg lär det inte saknas under dagen.

Vi på Prisma Kyrkslätt gör helt vanliga jobb, men just nu befinner vi oss också i en särskilt spännande fas: Prisma byggs ut som bäst, och du får vara med och uppleva vår butiks utveckling från första parkett.

I den här rollen
- Möter du kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe <3
- Har du en glad och kundserviceinriktad attityd och vilja att lära dig nytt
- Tar du ansvar för ditt eget arbete och för att driva gemensamma saker framåt som en del av teamet
- Arbetar du tillsammans med resten av teamet i god anda och bidrar till att avdelningen fungerar väl
- Rör du på dig mycket, lyfter varor och arbetar i rask takt, så en god grundkondition är till nytta i jobbet
- Arbetar du i varierande skift under butikens öppettider mellan kl. 5 och 24, även under helgdagar
- Goda kunskaper i finska och kunskaper i svenska ses som en merit.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
- Möjlighet att utvecklas och utbilda dig.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån.

Lön
- Lön enligt handelns kollektivavtal (10,89 - 14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på båda finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till hela personalens gemensamma resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro per arbetad timme, baserat på företagets resultat och branschvisa mätare.

Om ett helt vanligt arbetsliv lockar, skicka in din ansökan!

Skicka in din ansökan helt senast söndag 9.8.2026 – men vänta inte i onödan, vi går igenom ansökningar redan innan ansökningstiden går ut. Närmare uppgifter om uppgiften får du av försäljningschef Agneta Lundell (agneta.lundell@sok.fi och tfn 0107626661). Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse.

**Vastaanottovirkailija, Glass Resort,**_Rovaniemi_

**Glass Resort** on uniikki, korkeatasoinen majoituskohde Joulupukin Pajakylässä Rovaniemellä. Hotelli tunnetaan **tyylikkäistä lasihuoneistoistaan**, yksilöllisestä palvelustaan ja tunnelmallisesta **Ravintola Galliksesta**, jossa lappilainen luonto kohtaa klassisen keittiön.

Etsimme nyt **vastaanottovirkailijaa** osaksi ammattitaitoista ja lämminhenkistä tiimiämme tulevalle talvikaudelle.

**Tehtäväsi:**

Vastaanottovirkailijana olet olennainen osa asiakkaan majoituskokemusta – toivotat vieraat lämpimästi tervetulleiksi, varmistat sujuvan sisään- ja uloskirjautumisen sekä huolehdit asiakaspalvelusta koko vierailun ajan. Työtehtäviin kuuluu myös varausjärjestelmän käyttö, sähköposti- ja puhelinviestintä sekä monipuoliset hotellin vastaanoton päivittäiset tehtävät. Toimit resortin päivittäisen toiminnan eräänlaisena hermokeskuksena tietäen missä mennään ja mitä tapahtuu.

**Etsimme henkilöä, joka:**

- On asiakaspalveluhenkinen, kohtelias ja ammattimainen

- Nauttii työstä kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa

- Toimii itsenäisesti ja oma-aloitteisesti myös kiireessä

- Hallitsee suomen ja englannin kielen sujuvasti – muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

- On motivoitunut oppimaan uutta ja kehittämään työyhteisöä

- Aiempi kokemus hotellityöstä ja varausjärjestelmistä (esim. MEWS) katsotaan eduksi


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Kokoaikaisen ja määräaikaisen työsuhteen n. 10.4.2027 asti

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan ja hyvinvointiedun

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä kansainvälisessä ja ainutlaatuisessa ympäristössä

- Mukavan ja sitoutuneen tiimin tuen

- Arvokasta kokemusta korkeatasoisen palvelun parissa


**Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, viimeistään lokakuun alussa.** Ravintola ja vastaanotto palvelevat päivittäin syyskuun puolesta välistä huhtikuun puoleenväliin, käytössä on työaikapankki. Työsopimus solmitaan **Glass Resortin** ja valitun henkilön välille.
